title: Design Verification Engineer - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for talented Design Verification Engineers to help verify and deliver Velaura’s next-generation Physical AI SoC. In this role, you will work closely with architects, RTL engineers, software engineers, and system teams to verify complex hardware blocks and system-level behavior across the entire platform.You will help establish confidence in the correctness, performance, reliability, and safety of the architecture—from individual RTL blocks to complete HW/SW systems running real-world workloads. We welcome engineers at all experience levels who enjoy understanding systems, finding corner cases, and solving challenging technical problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and execute verification strategies for key portions of the Velaura SoC.

* Build verification environments using SystemVerilog, UVM, C/C++, assertions, formal verification, emulation, and related methodologies.

* Collaborate with architects and RTL engineers to define verification plans, coverage goals, and correctness criteria.

* Verify compute engines, memory subsystems, interconnect fabrics, control processors, DMA engines, and other critical SoC infrastructure.

* Perform HW/SW co-verification involving firmware, drivers, runtime software, and operating system interactions.

* Verify performance, latency, bandwidth, QoS, and real-time system behavior under representative workloads.

* Develop assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and automated verification infrastructure.

* Participate in emulation, FPGA prototyping, and pre-silicon software bring-up activities.

* Drive bug investigation, root-cause analysis, and debug across hardware and software boundaries.

* Post-silicon debug and root cause analysis.

* Leverage modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted verification workflows, to improve productivity, quality, and coverage.

* Contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Experience verifying complex digital systems.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Strong understanding of computer architecture, microarchitecture, SoC architecture and digital design fundamentals.

* Experience with SystemVerilog, UVM, C/C++, assertions, coverage-driven verification, and related methodologies.

* Familiarity with formal verification techniques and tools.

* Understanding of memory systems, interconnect fabrics, caches, DMA engines, processors, or accelerator architectures.

* Experience debugging complex system-level issues.

* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with one or more of the following standards: ISO 26262, IEC 61508, IEC 61511, ISO 13849

* Experience with AI, machine learning, or edge AI hardware.

* Familiarity with robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, or industrial automation systems.

* Experience verifying QoS, latency-sensitive, or real-time systems.

* Experience with HW/SW co-verification and system-level validation.

* Exposure to performance modeling, profiling, and workload characterization.

* Experience using modern AI tools and workflows to accelerate engineering productivity.

* Background in CPUs, GPUs, AI accelerators, networking and communications silicon, storage and data movement architectures, robotics and autonomous systems, automotive and ADAS platforms, aerospace and defense systems,

real-time and safety-critical computing, or functional safety architectures and methodologies.

---------------------------

At Velaura, we believe exceptional talent deserves exceptional rewards. Compensation for this role includes a base salary and very competitive equity compensation, allowing team members to share in the company’s long-term success.

The base pay listed represents a good faith estimate that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation will depend on multiple factors, including the candidate's skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and geographic location.

In addition to base salary and equity compensation, Velaura offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; flexible work arrangements; professional development opportunities; and other benefits designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

title: RTL Engineer Memory Subsystem - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a talented RTL Engineer to help build Velaura's next-generation Physical AI SoC, with a focus on the high-speed, low-power memory subsystem that feeds the chip.

In this role, you will work closely with architects, performance modelers, software engineers, verification engineers, physical design teams, and memory IP and PHY partners to transform innovative architectural concepts into production silicon. You will own significant portions of the memory subsystem design, contribute to microarchitectural decisions, and help deliver high-performance, power-efficient hardware that enables the next generation of intelligent physical systems.

Physical AI workloads are memory-bound: bandwidth, latency, and power in the memory path directly gate what the chip can do. If pushing modern memory technologies to their limits at high speed and low power is the kind of problem you want to own, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, implement, and optimize RTL for the memory subsystem of the Velaura SoC, including memory controllers, fabric interfaces, and the logic that integrates with external memory PHYs.
* Own memory controller and PHY integration, including controller-to-PHY interfaces such as DFI, initialization and training flows, calibration, and bring-up hooks.
* Drive high-speed, low-power design of the memory path, including timing closure at high data rates, power-state management such as self-refresh and power-down modes, clock and power gating, and DVFS interactions.
* Work with software teams to define hardware interfaces, memory maps, execution flows, and performance-critical interactions such as scheduling, prefetching, and quality of service.
* Analyze bandwidth, latency, and utilization bottlenecks in the memory path and propose architectural and implementation improvements.
* Optimize designs for performance, power, area, scalability, and reliability, including RAS features such as ECC and error reporting in the memory path.
* Partner closely with verification and physical design teams throughout the development cycle, and with memory IP and PHY vendors during integration and silicon bring-up.
* Leverage modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development workflows, to improve productivity, quality, and design exploration.
* Participate in design reviews and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Experience designing RTL for complex digital systems, with hands-on ownership of memory subsystem blocks.
* Demonstrated experience integrating a memory controller with a memory PHY, including controller-to-PHY interfaces such as DFI, initialization and training sequences, and bring-up.
* Strong understanding of high-speed, low-power memory technologies such as LPDDR4, LPDDR4X, LPDDR5, LPDDR5X, DDR, and HBM, including their protocol, timing, and power-state behavior.
* Strong understanding of computer architecture, microarchitecture, and digital design fundamentals.
* Expert-level Verilog and SystemVerilog skills and experience with modern RTL design methodologies, including lint, clock-domain crossing analysis, synthesis-aware coding, and low-power intent.
* Familiarity with performance, power, and area tradeoffs in the memory path.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering environment.

* Familiarity with standard interconnect protocols such as AXI, CHI, and ACE on the controller's system-side interface, including quality-of-service mechanisms.
* Experience with memory controller and PHY bring-up on silicon, including training and calibration debug and margining.
* Knowledge of reliability, availability, and serviceability in the memory path, including inline and side-band ECC, scrubbing, poisoning, and error reporting.
* Experience with low-power design techniques and power management architectures across memory and clock and power domains.
* Experience developing a memory controller from the ground up, including command scheduling and arbitration, bank and rank management, refresh management, and reordering.
* Knowledge of functional safety standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL as they apply to memory-path design.
* Experience with AI, machine learning, or edge AI hardware, especially the memory access patterns of tensor workloads.
* Familiarity with robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, or industrial automation systems.

title: IAM Software Architect
description:
**Job Description:**

**Software Architect – IAM, AI & Zero Trust**
=============================================

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Department:** Digital Infrastructure & Platforms (IAM)

  

**Role Description**
--------------------

Are you a visionary software architect with a deep passion for modern cybersecurity, platform engineering, and identity governance? Airbus is seeking a **Software Development Architect** to own and evolve the architectural vision of our **IAM Self-Service Platform** .

  

As Airbus accelerates its Digital Transformation, Identity & Access Management (IAM) is moving from a back-office utility to a core strategic product. In this role, you will define the target architecture for our self-service tools, ensure seamless integration across hybrid and cloud environments, and systematically guide our identity ecosystem toward a **Zero Trust Architecture** (Never Trust, Always Verify).

  

Operating within our leadership squad alongside the **Product Manager** , **Technical Lead** , and **Techno-Functional BA** , you will bridge business needs and security mandates into resilient, scalable, and developer-friendly technical blueprints.

**Challenges & Strategic Impact**
---------------------------------

* **Agentic AI & Emerging Workloads:** Preparing identity frameworks to support non-human identities, AI agents, and automated machine-to-machine interactions over the next two years.
* **DevSecOps Integration:** Fully embedding Security by Design and DevSecOps principles into the software development architecture and release lifecycle.
* **Zero Trust Evolution:** Transforming legacy identity mechanisms into continuous, dynamic, risk-based access controls and identity governance.
* **Architectural Designs:** Architect highly performant, scalable software solutions that embed 'Security by Design' principles, driving rigorous quality and sustainability metrics while future-proofing the product roadmap which will be in-line with the IAM PSL objectives.
* **Developer & User Experience:** Designing zero-trust architectures that simplify access requests and self-service workflows for 130,000+ Airbus employees and external supply chain partners without creating operational friction.
* **Enterprise Security Standards:** Ensuring architectural alignment with Airbus Cybersecurity rules ("Blue Book"), global data privacy regulations (GDPR), EASA aviation compliance, and ITAR/EAR export control policies.
* **Identity & Access Management (IAM):** Establishing comprehensive IAM domain leadership and strategic focus to align identity security practices with modern enterprise architecture.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Architectural Vision & Zero Trust Strategy**

* Own the technical roadmap and target architecture for the **IAM Self-Service Platform** , ensuring high availability, security-by-design, and modern design patterns.
* Lead the architectural shift toward **Zero Trust Principles** , designing mechanisms for continuous authentication, dynamic authorization (ABAC/RBAC/PBAC), least-privilege access, and micro-segmentation integration.
Apply and adopt standard protocols (OIDC/OAuth2, SAML, SCIM, FIDO2) across enterprise web applications, APIs, and services to ensure architectural compliance.  

  

### **2. Platform Design & Identity Integration**

* Design scalable integration patterns between the core self-service portal (Python/React) and identity systems, governance platforms, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Define API-first governance, microservices architecture, and secure data access layers for identity workflow engines and automation scripts.
* Establish non-functional requirements (NFRs) including system scalability, latency targets, failover resilience, and audit logging for security compliance.
* Establish and mandate core architectural principles, enterprise design patterns, and robust application frameworks to drive scalable identity integrations.
* Lead ARD (Architecture Reference Document) management, translating complex IAM requirements into precise network models, Zero Trust security views, and modular software architecture breakdowns.
Design comprehensive Observability and Telemetry strategies (logging, tracing, and monitoring) to ensure real-time visibility into identity workflows, system health, and security events.  

  

### **3. Product Quad, Architect Network & Engineering Collaboration**

* Partner with the **Product Manager (PM) / Product Owner (PO)** to translate business vision and security roadmaps into architecturally sound product epics.
* Work in tandem with the **Technical Lead** to guide engineering teams, ensuring implementation details adhere to the master architectural design without creating technical debt.
* Collaborate with the **Techno-Functional BA** to validate technical feasibility, security constraints, and boundary conditions for new self-service workflows.
* Collaborate with **cross-functional domain leaders** —including Enterprise, Cyber Security, Infrastructure, and PSL Architects, alongside Data Officers and Quality/Eco-Design Experts—to drive comprehensive architectural reviews and integrate strategic recommendations.
Partner closely with Enterprise, Product, and PSL Architects to align platform design with overall IAM domain strategy and enterprise architecture principles.  

  

### **4. Technical Governance & Innovation**

* Serve as the primary representative for the product on the internal **Architecture Review Board (ARB)** and Cybersecurity committees.
* Conduct Proof of Concepts (PoCs) for emerging identity technologies, passwordless access, and identity threat detection and response (ITDR).
* Author and govern comprehensive **Architectural Requirements Dossiers (ARDs)** , technical standards, engineering specifications, and integration patterns, providing actionable blueprints that guide and accelerate internal development teams.
Drive proactive Threat Modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and risk assessments during the design phase to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities before development begins.  

  

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* **Experience:** **12+ years** of software engineering experience, with at least **4+ years** operating as an Enterprise/Software/Solution Architect in large-scale IAM or enterprise security environments.
* **Architecture & Frameworks:** Expertise in Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, API Gateway patterns, RESTful APIs, and Cloud-native designs (Azure/AWS/GCP).
* **Identity Domain Mastery (Preferred):** Comprehensive Identity & Access Management (IAM) domain expertise, including familiarity with IGA, PAM, or core IAM frameworks, as well as strong architectural knowledge of:

* Protocols: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0, SCIM, FIDO2/WebAuthn.
* Identity Engines: Active Directory, Azure AD / Entra ID, Ping Identity, Okta, or SailPoint.
* Concepts: Zero Trust Architecture (NIST SP 800-207), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), RBAC/ABAC models.

* **Technical Stack Literacy:** Strong architectural knowledge of **Python** , **React** , **SQL Server** , and **PowerShell/Automation workflows** .
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills within a multi-cultural, international environment (India <-> Europe), capable of bridging executive strategy, security auditing, and engineering teams.
* **Certifications (Nice to Have):** CISSP, CCSP, TOGAF, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert, or AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, Archimate.

title: Senior System Performance Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a "learning machine" that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life's work to amplify human imagination and intelligence. Make the choice to join us today!

As part of the Silicon Solutions Team, we architect and deliver groundbreaking solutions for productizing NVIDIA's chips into consumer, professional, server, mobile, and automotive markets. Silicon characterization, correlation to arch & design expectations, finalize product specifications, develop productization techniques and infrastructure around it are part of our responsibilities. Dealing with challenges of the latest process node technologies is also part of the work. Join this dynamic team as a Senior System Perf Engineer, and help craft the future of computing in Bengaluru.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Lead the productization of Performance controllers from pre-silicon planning through bring-up, tuning, validation, and production.
* Collaborate with architecture, design, firmware, and software teams to define controller requirements & features , identify improvements and translate new capabilities into production-ready solutions.
* Characterize and tune controller behaviour across workloads, operating conditions, silicon variation, and product power and thermal limits. Maximize the perf and Perf/Watt with-in architectural bottlenecks & limitations, Power/Thermal system limits to provide best customer experience for the products
* Correlate silicon behaviour with pre-silicon expectations, debug & resolve complex problems during bring up and final closed loop performance stage involving silicon HW, firmware, software, power delivery network, system thermals etc.
Apply AI/ML and data-driven methods to analyze silicon characterization and HW telemetry data, identify anomalies and trends, accelerate controller tuning and improve debug as well as silicon validation execution efficiency.  

**What we need to See:**

* B. Tech or M. Tech in Electronics Engineering stream.
* At least 5+ years of proven experience in silicon validation, system level design, and power/performance optimization.
* Strong understanding of aspects related to silicon power and performance, technology node impacts, Hardware and Software interactions at system level.
* Hands-on experience with silicon bring up, validation and productization
* Good HW architectural understanding and orientation
* Very good problem solving and hardware debugging skills.
* Strong good data analysis and logical reasoning skills.
* Strong familiarity with HW lab environment.
Must be a great teammate and ready to collaborate with global teams from diverse cultural backgrounds in a high energy environment.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Extensive background in DVFS, voltage/frequency management, HW telemetries, Performance throttling, silicon protection mechanisms on advanced ASIC/SoC products.
* Contributions that improved controller behaviour, silicon performance, power efficiency, thermal management, bring-up/productization methodologies.
* Experience connecting controller behaviour across simulation, silicon, firmware, and system-level measurements and converting findings into production tuning.
Experience applying AI/ML to engineering workflows, such as controller tuning, characterization analytics, anomaly detection, or debug assistants deployed beyond personal use.  

  

With every new architecture and process node, balancing performance against power and thermal limits becomes tougher. Our controllers are at the forefront of this issue: drawing out the performance the silicon was crafted to achieve while shielding it when workloads push its limits. If you like understanding dynamic silicon behaviour, addressing hardware-software challenges, and influencing NVIDIA products at scale, we'd love to connect!

description:
**General Information**

**Job Title:** Linux System and Hardware Administrator

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**Role Overview:**

The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ’s Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. You will run routine server administration, set up and recover devices across Linux, Windows, and macOS, and resolve support tickets, working from the runbooks, policies, and security controls set by the Head of Corporate Technology and alongside colleagues based mainly in Canada.

**Mandate:**

* Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks
* Comfort working across Windows 11 and macOS alongside Linux. Strong Linux plus one of the other two is acceptable
* Experience administering a directory and identity platform, such as Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or an on-premise Windows Active Directory domain
* Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement, plus networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification. Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) is a strong advantage
* An active Linux certification, such as CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA, or LFCS
* Microsoft Intune administration (device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment)
* Exposure to DevOps tooling such as Docker, cloud virtual machines (Azure or AWS), or CI/CD runners
* PowerShell or Python scripting
* Any certification listed on your resume must be active.
* Successful candidates who do not yet hold AZ-104 and AZ-305 will be expected to complete both after joining.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Hardware & Device Support**

* Set up, image, and configure Windows 11 laptops and Mac devices for new joiners, and enrol them in device management
* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors
* Maintain the asset register for every device, linked to the employee it is assigned to
* Support Bengaluru office equipment, including network devices, Wi-Fi, printers, and meeting room technology

**Linux System Administration**

* Perform routine Linux server administration: user accounts, permissions, service restarts, disk space, and log checks
* Apply OS updates and patches following the schedule and runbooks set by Corporate Technology
* Monitor server health alerts and escalate issues to senior team members with clear notes
* Run scheduled backup checks and report any failures

**User Support**

* Respond to and resolve support tickets for hardware, software, accounts, and access
* Support Microsoft 365 account setup, password resets, and MFA enrolment
* Escalate issues you cannot resolve to the right owner in Corporate Technology or DevOps, with the steps already taken
* Give staff practical guidance on using their devices safely

**Security & Compliance**

* Confirm endpoint protection, disk encryption, and required updates are active on every device
* Follow the access, device, and data handling policies set by Corporate Technology
* Report suspected security incidents immediately
* Support license and subscription tracking by assigning and reclaiming seats for joiners and leavers

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Keep tickets, asset records, and runbooks current
* Document recurring issues and their fixes so the team can resolve them faster next time
* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**

**30 Days In**

* Learn FIQ’s systems, tools, ticketing process, and runbooks
* Set up devices for new joiners independently
* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

**60 Days In**

* Resolve support tickets within agreed response and resolution times
* Handle routine Linux administration and patching independently using runbooks
* Own joiner and leaver device workflows from start to finish

**90 Days In**

* Be the go-to contact for hardware and device support in India
* Add runbook entries for the most common recurring issues
* Deliver at least one script that removes a manual step from a routine task

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiner devices ready on Day 1, and leaver devices recovered on time
* Asset register accuracy
* Patch compliance on assigned servers and devices
* Internal customer satisfaction

**Interview Process:**

* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition team
* A 90-minute in-person technical assessment at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. The first part is scenario-based Q&A. The second part is hands-on at a computer: you will work in a Linux environment, set up a web server, and troubleshoot basic operations on that server, and you will be questioned on networking and typical hardware issues

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don’t just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you’re leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

Here’s what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Career Growth That Matters**  
We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751369

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title:** AI Platform Engineering Manager

  

**Role Overview:**

EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team is looking for an **AI Platform Engineering Manager** to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively.

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own platform deployment** for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* **Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* **Architect for scale and resilience** — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* **Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers**, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems.
* **Manage model-hosting strategy**, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* **Build observability and monitoring** for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* **Drive security, compliance, and governance** of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* **Optimize infrastructure cost and performance**, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* **Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap**, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

  

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5–8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments.
* Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling
* Understanding of model-hosting economics, GPU resource management, and inference optimization techniques (quantization, batching, caching).
* Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

  

**Soft Skills / Leadership**

* Proven ability to lead engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working with Data SMEs, Product, Responsible AI, and business stakeholders.
* Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership.
* Comfortable operating in a "zero to one" environment — building platform foundations rather than maintaining existing ones.

  

**What We Offer:**

* A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact.
* Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement.
* A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth.
* Comprehensive support and guidance to develop into a transformative leader, equipped to navigate and excel in today's rapidly evolving technological landscape.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Experience designing, deploying, or operating workloads on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Experience developing automation or scripts in Python, Shell, or Groovy.
* Experience implementing identity and access management (IAM), role-based access control (RBAC), Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security (SSL/TLS), and compliance monitoring for cloud platforms.

* Elastic Certified Engineer, Elastic Observability Engineer, or OpenSearch Practitioner certification.
* Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect certification.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification.
* DevOps or site reliability engineering certification.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. description:

**Job Role -** **AWS Platform Engineer – Security Specialist**

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Design, build, and secure **AWS platform infrastructure** using **Infrastructure as Code** (**Terraform** and **CloudFormation**).
* Design and build **event-driven security architectures** using AWS EventBridge, AWS Lambda (Python), and AWS Systems Manager (SSM) for **automated Security Findings routing and auto-remediation of detective controls**.
* Integrate **AWS Security Hub** and **GuardDuty** with ITSM tools (specifically **Jira**) to build automated, environment-aware ticket creation and routing workflows based on resource tagging and severity.
* Enforce strict **tagging governance** across multiple layers (Authoring, Build, API via **Service Control Policies/Tag Policies**, and Runtime via **AWS Config**) to ensure accurate resource attribution and compliance.
* Secure and govern the **AWS account vending process**, ensuring newly provisioned accounts automatically inherit clean security baselines, delegated administrator configurations, and automated suppression rules.
* Implement and manage centralized network security controls at scale using **AWS Firewall Manager** via **Terraform**.
* Develop secure **CI/CD reference pipelines**, integrating **automated static analysis** and security scanning gates to block non-compliant infrastructure deployments.
* Transition manual security reviews to continuous, automated assessments using **AWS Security Hub (CSPM)**, **AWS Config**, and **AWS Security Agent**.
* Rationalize and manage **AWS Config conformance packs** and Security Hub standards across multi-partition environments (**Commercial, GovCloud**) to eliminate redundant findings.
* Support incident response activities by expanding **AWS Security Incident Response (SIR)** adoption, configuring auto-triage for GuardDuty/Security Hub findings to reduce alert noise.
* Collaborate with platform engineering, network engineering, and security operations teams to define secure architecture patterns, exception handling, and remediation SLAs.

**Must Have Skills**
====================

* **Experience: 7+ years** of overall experience in **AWS Cloud** **platform/infrastructure** **engineering**, with **3-5 years** specifically dedicated to **cloud security and automation**.
* **AWS Security Services:** Deep, hands-on knowledge of **AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, AWS Config, IAM, KMS**, and **AWS Firewall Manager**.
* **AWS Governance & Organizations:** Strong expertise in **AWS Organizations**, specifically implementing **Service Control Policies (SCPs)**, **Tag Policies**, and **Delegated Administrator models** across multiple accounts.
* **Security Automation:** Deep hands-on experience with AWS EventBridge, AWS Lambda, and SSM documents for building **event-driven security workflows and auto-remediation scripts**.
* **Scripting:** High proficiency in **Python (Boto3)** and **Bash** for security automation and API integrations.
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Strong hands-on experience writing and managing infrastructure using **Terraform** and **AWS CloudFormation**.
* **CI/CD & Pipeline Security:** Experience building secure pipelines and integrating IaC static analysis tools such as **Checkov, tfsec, cfn-lint**, and **Conftest**.
* **Multi-Partition Experience:** Proven experience managing and securing AWS environments across different partitions, specifically **AWS Commercial** and **AWS GovCloud**.
* **Compliance Frameworks:** Strong familiarity with **FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, CIS Benchmarks**, and **AWS Foundational Security Best Practices (FSBP)**.
* **ITSM Integration:** Experience automating **Jira workflows** via API/webhooks directly from AWS services to route security findings to engineering teams.
* **Core Security Concepts:** Strong understanding of **cloud security models, zero-trust principles, least privilege, encryption**, and **network security fundamentals**.
* **Soft Skills:** Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work across cross-functional engineering, finance, and security teams (e.g., participating in Tag Governance Boards).

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience securing multi-cloud (AWS + GCP/Azure) environments.
* Experience with container security for ECS/EKS (image scanning, runtime protection, IAM roles for tasks).
* Knowledge of SIEM platforms like Sumo Logic, Splunk, or Datadog.
* Experience with AWS Macie, Detective, and advanced data governance solutions.
* Exposure to zero-trust security, identity federation, and SSO (Azure AD/Okta).
* Familiarity with incident response processes and playbook automation (SOAR).
* Experience designing isolation, or exfiltration-prevention controls.
* Additional security certifications (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty)
* Understanding of SOC processes, including Tier-1/2/3 triage, playbook execution, case management, ticketing systems, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Hands-on knowledge of security incident management, including detection, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews.

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Director, AI & Information Security

**Role Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Senior Staff Cyber Security Architect to design, implement, and govern security architecture across enterprise networks, endpoints, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and AI ecosystems. This role is critical to establishing security standards, driving secure-by-design initiatives, and ensuring our technology landscape remains resilient against evolving cyber threats. You will serve as a trusted technical leader, bridging business and technology to enable innovation through secure, scalable architecture.

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Define and maintain** enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.
* **Architect and govern** secure cloud landing zones, security guardrails, and DevSecOps shift-left practices across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.
* **Establish and enforce** Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* **Lead the development** of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* **Design** enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.
* **Oversee** SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) and establish comprehensive controls for enterprise platforms (e.g., M365, Salesforce, Workday).
* **Develop** robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* **Conduct** comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* **Provide architectural guidance** during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* **Education Requirements:** B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.
* Cloud-specific security certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer Associate, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
* Experience or certifications related to AI/LLM Security (e.g., CAISP) and data privacy (CIPP).
* Master's degree in a relevant technical or engineering field.

**Location**

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

### **The Opportunity**

This is a role for a visionary technical leader who operates as a strategic force multiplier for the entire engineering organization. As a Principal Platform Engineer (SDE4) at NAB, you will be responsible for setting the long-term technical vision for critical domains of our engineering platform. You will tackle our most complex and ambiguous challenges, pioneering innovative solutions that advance the state-of-the-art for financial technology at scale. Your influence will extend far beyond the Platform Engineering & Developer Experience teams; you will collaborate with senior technology leaders, establish engineering standards, and mentor other senior engineers, shaping the technical fabric of the bank. If you are driven by the challenge of solving large-scale distributed systems problems and have a passion for creating an environment where hundreds of engineers can thrive, this is your platform to make a lasting impact.

### **What You'll Do**

As a SDE4, your focus will be on strategy, architecture, and technical leadership, driving the long-term success and scalability of the NAB Engineering Foundation.

* **Define Technical Vision and Strategy:** Define and own the long-term technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for critical platform domains, such as our enterprise container platform, multi-cloud infrastructure strategy, or core developer experience. Your work will set the direction for years to come.
* **Architect for the Future:** Lead the architectural design of complex, cross-functional platform solutions. You will ensure these systems are secure, compliant, highly scalable, and cost-effective, anticipating future business needs and technological shifts.
* **Solve Ambiguous, Large-Scale Problems:** Tackle the most technically challenging and ill-defined problems within the platform space. This involves deep-dive analysis, prototyping, and creating novel solutions that push the boundaries of what's possible.
* **Champion Engineering Excellence:** Act as a steward for engineering quality across the orgs. You will establish and evangelize best practices, author design documents and RFCs, and lead by example to cultivate a culture of high-performance engineering.
* **Mentor and Elevate Senior Talent:** Serve as a mentor and technical guide to other senior engineers (SDE3s) and team leads. You will be a "force multiplier," elevating the technical capabilities of the entire organization through your guidance and expertise.
* **Collaborate with Senior Leadership:** Partner with senior technology leaders (Heads of Engineering) to align the platform strategy with NAB's overarching business and technology objectives, ensuring your work delivers maximum strategic value.

### **What You'll Bring**

We are seeking a world-class engineer with a history of strategic impact and a reputation for technical excellence and thought leadership.

* **Experience:** 9+ years of experience in software and platform engineering, with significant time spent in a technical leadership, staff, or principal engineer capacity.
* **Distributed Systems Mastery:** Deep, recognized expertise in designing, building, and operating large-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems on multi-cloud platforms (AWS and Google Cloud / Azure).
* **Cloud-Native Authority:** Mastery of Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem. You have architected and operated Kubernetes platforms at enterprise scale, likely in complex, multi-tenant environments, and have a profound understanding of its internals.
* **Strategic Influence:** Proven ability to drive large-scale, cross-team technical initiatives from conception through to production. You are adept at building consensus and influencing technical direction without direct authority.
* **Exceptional Communication:** World-class communication and interpersonal skills. You can crisply articulate highly complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, from junior engineers to executive leadership.
* **Visionary Mindset:** A strategic thinker who can look beyond immediate problems to anticipate future challenges and opportunities, translating them into a coherent technical strategy.
* **AI Innovation:** Lead organizational AI platform strategy and GenAI technology adoption. Design intelligent platforms with autonomous capabilities and predictive operations, like developer agents, code review agents, test agents, SRE agents etc.
* **Multi-** **Cloud architecture & Strategy:** You have experience in designing and architecting, multi-cloud / cross-cloud-platform systems, and defining clear strategies for maintaining multi-cloud infrastructure at scale.

* **Risk & Security:** As part of being a banking / financial institution, security and risk in ingrained in our daily activity. A key competency would be not just building great tech but also building with the best practices of security & risk ingrained in our decisions and strategies.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

At Arctic Wolf, you won't just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve, you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights, and IDC MarketScape, but what matters most is the work behind it. We deliver real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora® Platform.
  
  
If you're looking for meaningful work, smart teammates, and the chance to make a real impact in a high growth company that's redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you.
  
  
Our mission is simple. End Cyber Risk. We're looking for an **Engineering Manager** to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview and Objective**  
  
The Engineering Manager will contribute to our **Sensor Platform Delivery team** by leading the site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout functions that take our network security sensor platform from a passing build to a healthy, verified state across thousands of sensors deployed in customer environments worldwide.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
**AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER AT ARCTIC WOLF, YOU WILL:**

* Lead the engineering teams across site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout for our network security sensor platform.
* Own release criteria and rollout decisions for firmware, kernel, and service updates across our global sensor fleet, including staged rolling deployments and rollback calls.
* Drive fleet reliability targets, including availability, upgrade success rate, and data flow continuity, across multi region cloud infrastructure on AWS.
* Oversee the physical lab environment, including build servers, power distribution units (PDUs), and virtualized test fleets, keeping lab configuration aligned with production.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines and automated test frameworks spanning unit, integration, simulation, and full physical system testing, and reduce flaky tests to improve signal quality.
* Partner with infrastructure and security teams on container orchestration, database management, and core networking protocols, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, to support sensor telemetry and detection workflows.
* Build and maintain the runbooks, dashboards, and on-call processes that your team, solution engineers, and solution architects depend on during incident response.
Mentor and grow a team of engineers, strengthening people management practices and cross functional partnership with solution engineering managers and solution architects.  

**YOUR EXPERIENCE MIGHT LOOK LIKE:**

* 10- 15 yrs of experience which should include 5+ years in software engineering, including 2 or more years managing engineering teams.
* Hands on experience with test infrastructure, lab environments, and CI/CD pipelines, including debugging across physical and virtualized systems.
* A track record in release engineering and platform reliability, with experience improving release confidence across distributed systems.
* Experience operating services on AWS, including container orchestration and managed database administration.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, and of security protocols relevant to network security appliances.
* Experience managing or partnering closely with QA and DevOps functions, and comfort working alongside solution engineers and solution architects.
* Strong written communication skills, with experience producing runbooks, postmortems, and release notes that on-call engineers depend on.

**On-Camera Policy**  
  
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
  
  
**About Arctic Wolf**  
  
At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021 to 2025), Best Places to Work, USA (2021 to 2025), Great Place to Work, Canada (2021 to 2024), Great Place to Work, UK (2024 to 2026), and Kununu Top Company, Germany (2024 to 2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
  
  
**Our Values**  
  
Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that, by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk, we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
  
  
We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.
  
  
We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment, ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business and customer information.

  

Depending on the role, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

Your job is just one part of your life. When you bring your ideas, energy, and hunger for growth, you’ll be recognised and rewarded for your contribution in return. You’ll have our support to excel for our customers, deliver positive change for our communities and grow your career.

NAB has established NAB Innovation Centre India as a centre for operations and technology excellence to support NAB deliver faster, better, and more personalized experience to customers and colleagues.

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

**The Opportunity**

As a Senior Platform Engineer (SDE3) at NAB, you will be a technical leader, architect, and mentor, driving the evolution of the core platforms that power our entire engineering organization. This role moves beyond feature delivery to owning the design and implementation of large-scale, resilient, and secure systems. You will tackle complex technical challenges, such as building ephemeral on-demand environments from scratch, optimizing our multi-cloud Kubernetes strategy, and embedding security deep within the software development lifecycle. You will have a significant impact not only on our technology but also on our colleagues, actively mentoring junior engineers and fostering a culture of technical excellence. If you are a seasoned engineer passionate about building world-class platforms and leading by example, this is your opportunity to shape the future of banking technology.

**What You'll Do**

As a SDE3, you will be responsible for the architecture and delivery of critical platform capabilities, ensuring they meet the highest standards of security, scalability, and reliability.

* **Lead Technical Design and Architecture:** Lead the architectural design and implementation of major platform initiatives. You will be responsible for creating robust, scalable, and secure solutions that solve complex problems for our internal development teams.
* **Build Risk-Mitigated Financial Systems:** Architect and build highly available and fault-tolerant systems that meet the stringent security, compliance, and risk mitigation requirements of a large-scale financial institution.
* **Drive DevSecOps Adoption:** Champion and implement DevSecOps best practices across the platform. You will design and integrate automated security scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance checks directly into our CI/CD pipelines to create a secure-by-default environment.
* **Master Multi-Cloud and Kubernetes:** Act as a subject matter expert on our multi-cloud (AWS and Google Cloud) infrastructure and our enterprise-scale Kubernetes platform. You will drive improvements in scalability, performance, and cost-efficiency.
* **Define and Manage Reliability:** Define, measure, and evolve platform Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets, using data-driven approaches to balance innovation speed with operational stability.
* **On Demand Environments:** Design advanced ephemeral environments with intelligent resource management and cost optimization
* **Mentor and Develop Talent:** Actively mentor SDE1 and SDE2 engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pair programming. You will play a crucial role in leveling up the technical capabilities of the entire team and fostering an inclusive, learning-based culture.
* **Influence Technical Strategy:** Collaborate with architects and other senior engineers to influence the technical direction of the NAB Engineering Foundation, evaluating new technologies and advocating for best practices.

**What You'll Bring**

We are looking for a technical leader with deep expertise in building and operating large-scale platforms and a passion for mentoring others.

* **Experience:** 8-11 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, backend or a related field, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex, mission-critical infrastructure projects.
* **Multi-Cloud Expertise:** Deep, hands-on expertise in both AWS and Azure. You should have experience designing, deploying, and managing solutions that span multiple cloud environments.
* **Container Orchestration:** Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes and the broader cloud-native ecosystem. This includes a deep understanding of Kubernetes networking (CNI), security (RBAC, Network Policies), storage, and scalability patterns.
* **Secure CI/CD Architecture:** Extensive experience architecting and building secure, fully automated CI/CD pipelines for complex microservices architectures. You understand how to embed security and compliance into the entire lifecycle.
* **Nack for Risk and Security:** As part of being a banking / financial institution, security and risk in ingrained in our daily activity. A key competency would be not just building great tech but also building with the best practices of security & risk ingrained in our daily decisions.
* **Strong Architectural Skills:** Proven ability to make sound architectural decisions, considering trade-offs between performance, reliability, security, and cost. You can clearly articulate and document your designs.
* **Leadership and Mentorship:** Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing junior engineers, with a passion for sharing knowledge and elevating the skills of those around you. **Should have** **experience in leading / inherently managing a team size of atleast 4-5 people.**

**Good to Have**

These qualifications demonstrate a forward-thinking and strategic approach to platform engineering:

* Experience with modern CI/CD orchestration and continuous delivery platforms like Harness.
* Experience in designing and building internal developer platforms or self-service portals using frameworks like Backstage, potentially leveraging TypeScript for custom plugins.
* A keen interest in applying AI/GenAI to platform engineering challenges such as predictive scaling, anomaly detection, or intelligent cost optimization, developer agents, pipeline agents, test agents etc.
* Familiarity with FinOps principles and practices for managing cloud costs at scale.

**A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:**

Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.

**More focus on you:**

We’re committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. Through our three industry-leading businesses, advanced research, and world-class engineering capabilities, we are pushing the boundaries of science to connect and protect our world.

**Collins Aerospace**, an RTX business, is redefining aerospace through intelligent, technologically advanced solutions that make aviation safer, smarter, and more connected. Join our team and contribute to next-generation aerospace technologies that shape the future of flight.

### **The Opportunity**

Are you ready to lead the development of advanced avionics systems that meet the highest standards of safety, reliability, and performance?

We are seeking an experienced **Principal Systems Engineer – Communication, Navigation & Surveillance (CNS)** to drive systems engineering activities across the complete product development lifecycle. In this role, you will provide technical leadership, translate customer needs into robust system architectures, and guide the development, integration, verification, and certification of complex, safety-critical avionics solutions.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, influence system-level design decisions, champion automation and engineering excellence, and mentor technical talent. Your expertise will help deliver reliable, certification-ready avionics systems that support the next generation of aerospace innovation.

If you thrive on solving complex engineering challenges and leading teams toward technical excellence, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As a technical leader within our CNS engineering organization, you will:

* **Drive end-to-end systems engineering:** Lead the decomposition of customer requirements into clear, traceable system-, subsystem-, and component-level requirements.
* **Provide technical leadership:** Guide and mentor Systems Engineers developing complex CNS solutions, fostering collaboration, accountability, and engineering excellence.
* **Architect safety-critical avionics systems:** Define system architectures, functional decomposition, interfaces, and design documentation for advanced surveillance and avionics products, including systems requiring Design Assurance Level (DAL) A compliance.
* **Lead requirements management:** Establish, capture, analyze, trace, and manage system requirements using tools such as Jama and IBM DOORS.
* **Shape integration and verification strategies:** Develop comprehensive system integration, verification, and validation approaches, including test plans, procedures, execution strategies, and detailed test reports.
* **Ensure compliance and certification readiness:** Develop certification artifacts and support regulatory compliance activities aligned with applicable aerospace development and safety assessment standards.
* **Leverage automation and digital engineering:** Develop Python-based tools and automation solutions that improve engineering productivity, verification efficiency, and process consistency.
* **Enable seamless system integration:** Collaborate with software architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and sustainable system solutions.
* **Apply industry-leading engineering standards:** Drive adherence to ARP4754A/B, ARP4761, and applicable avionics communication and interface standards.
* **Champion continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to optimize engineering processes, advance technical roadmaps, and strengthen organizational capabilities.
* **Develop engineering talent:** Mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and contribute to talent development, performance management, and a culture of continuous learning.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
* **11–15 years of experience in avionics systems engineering**, with demonstrated expertise in complex engineering environments.
* At least 8 years of experience across the complete Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements development, architecture, design, implementation, integration, validation, and verification.
* At least 8 years of experience capturing and managing system requirements using Jama and/or IBM DOORS.
* At least 9 years of experience developing system architectures, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), functional decomposition, and system design documentation.
* At least 8 years of experience developing integration, verification, and validation strategies for safety-critical avionics systems.
* At least 8 years of experience working with avionics communication protocols and interfaces, including AFDX, ARINC 429, ARINC 615/615A, and Ethernet.
* At least 8 years of experience applying aerospace development and safety assessment guidelines, including ARP4754A/B and ARP4761.
* At least 6 years of experience supporting certification activities involving the FAA, certification authorities, or internal certification organizations.
* At least 8 years of experience working in Agile development environments using tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* At least 6 years of experience developing engineering automation tools using Python.
* Hands-on experience with engineering tools such as Jama, IBM DOORS, Git, Subversion, and RapiTest.
* Experience integrating hardware and software within complex avionics platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, technical decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in one or more of the following areas will strengthen your profile:

* **Avionics navigation products:** Good to have 2-3 years of experience with navigation products, including radar altimeters and communication/navigation radio applications.
* **Certification and compliance:** At least 3 years of experience supporting Stages of Involvement (SOI) audits, certification reviews, and compliance evidence preparation.
* **Aerospace certification standards:** Working knowledge of RTCA DO-178, DO-160, DO-254, and DO-297.
* **System integration and verification:** At least 5 years of experience performing system integration and verification testing.
* **Avionics performance standards:** Experience with Minimum Operational Performance Standards (MOPS) for avionics systems.
* **Broader avionics expertise:** Understanding of Communication, Navigation & Surveillance (CNS), Flight Management Systems (FMS), Flight Control Systems (FCS), and cockpit display systems.
* **Technical leadership:** Experience mentoring engineers, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and driving technical decisions for complex aerospace products.

**What Makes You Successful?**
------------------------------

You will thrive in this role if you:

* Approach complex engineering challenges with a systems-thinking mindset and strong analytical judgment.
* Translate customer and stakeholder needs into clear requirements and robust technical solutions.
* Lead cross-functional teams through challenging design, integration, verification, and certification activities.
* Demonstrate exceptional attention to detail when developing safety-critical systems.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively and build alignment across engineering disciplines.
* Embrace innovation, automation, and continuous improvement to enhance engineering effectiveness.
* Enjoy mentoring others and raising the technical capabilities of the wider team.
* Remain focused on quality, safety, and customer success in a dynamic engineering environment.

Learn More & Apply Now

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.

Remote: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). If you live within a reasonable commute of an RTX site with other colleagues you interact with, your manager will discuss whether there is a

degree of onsite presence associated with this role.

Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility.

Engineering/Other Technical Positions: Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of prior relevant experience unless prohibited by local laws/regulations.

**Why Join Collins Aerospace?**

At Collins Aerospace, your work directly impacts millions of passengers and defense personnel worldwide. You'll collaborate with some of the industry's brightest minds to solve complex engineering challenges while advancing technologies that make aviation safer and more sustainable.
