title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (Mission Control & Ground Segment)
description:
ReOrbit is looking for a Senior Cloud Infra Engineer to own and scale our Azure cloud infrastructure from our Bangalore office.

As our Senior Cloud Infra Engineer, you will be the technical owner of ReOrbit’s cloud platform, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Bangalore as part of our two-hub operating model. You will take over work currently delivered by an external DevOps and infrastructure consultant, with structured knowledge transfer in your first months.

You will be responsible for the architecture, automation, security and reliability of our cloud environment. As the role matures, you will grow into owning the cloud infrastructure, automation and reliability engineering for our Mission Control and Ground Segment.

It’s an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer

**Responsibilities**

* Own Azure platform architecture, provisioning and governance across ReOrbit’s cloud environment.
* Manage network infrastructure design, security groups, VPNs and connectivity.
* Own infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / ARM) for repeatable, auditable deployments.
* Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Drive infrastructure automation, including provisioning, configuration management and self-healing systems.
* Implement and own monitoring, alerting and observability tooling across cloud infrastructure.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning, and lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Implement security controls across cloud infrastructure in partnership with the Head of Security.
* Document architecture, runbooks and procedures, lead knowledge transfer from the current external DevOps consultant, and coordinate with vendors.
* Grow into ownership of Mission Control and Ground Segment cloud infrastructure, automation and reliability engineering as the role matures.

**Skills and Requirements**

* 8–10 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud or Infrastructure engineering roles.
* Deep hands-on Microsoft Azure experience (compute, networking, storage, IAM).
* CI/CD pipeline design and infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform / ARM / Bicep).
* Strong networking and security fundamentals (VPNs, segmentation, access control).
* Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent).
* Experience owning production infrastructure reliability and incident response.
* Comfortable working toward mission-critical, high-availability system ownership.
* Fluent English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in aerospace, satellite or other mission-critical operational environments.
* Kubernetes or other container orchestration experience.
* Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-500 or equivalent).
* Experience transitioning work from external consultants or vendors into an internal team.
* Scripting ability (Python, PowerShell or Bash) for automation.
* Exposure to ground segment, SCADA or other real-time operational systems.
* Experience scaling infrastructure ownership from start-up to enterprise.

**Working mode**

* Location: Bangalore, India, working from the office with one work-from-home day per week.
* On-call support may be required outside working hours. Please make sure you are comfortable with this before applying.

**What does ReOrbit do?**

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.

ReOrbit’s top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiary in Bariloche, Argentina.

**Working at ReOrbit**

At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.

We offer

* Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.
* Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space .
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.
* We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion.
* We support relocation and integration into Finnish society, find some experiences about relocation here

Please, submit your application as soon as possible - we are excited to hear from you and can’t wait to discover your unique skills and experiences.

*For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

description:

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead technical design, team members and delivery across projects and squads, providing expert guidance on Pega architecture, integration and tooling.

You will shape reusable, scalable and secure solutions using modern engineering practices, promote clean code, automation and performance optimisation, and mentor engineers to uplift squad capability.

**Architecture & Design:** Lead architecture reviews and design assurance, challenge solution choices where required, document key architecture decisions and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security and engineering standards.

**Enterprise Integrations:** Design integration architecture across Pega and enterprise platforms using APIs, REST services, events and asynchronous patterns, including error handling, resiliency, observability and service reuse.

**Data Architecture:** Establish sound Pega data architecture covering system-of-record boundaries, data objects, data pages, caching, persistence and data access patterns.

**Performance & Scalability:** Drive architecture for performance, scalability, availability, security and recoverability. Use Pega diagnostic and monitoring capabilities to identify bottlenecks and guide remediation.

**Pega Cloud & DevOps:** Provide technical leadership for Pega Cloud, environment topology, deployment architecture, release engineering and CI/CD, including quality gates and automated testing.

**Security:** Set the approach for Pega security architecture, including authentication, SSO integration, authorisation, access groups and roles, privileges, data access controls and secure integrations.

**Pega Modernisation:** Lead technical strategy for platform upgrades, Pega version adoption, Constellation modernisation and technical debt remediation.

**Engineering Capability:** Mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, share technical knowledge and uplift capability across squads.

**Stakeholder Collaboration:** Partner with solution architects, engineers, product owners, security, infrastructure and integration teams to translate complex business requirements into practical and scalable solutions.

**Pega Experience & Architecture:**

* 12+ years of hands-on experience building capabilities using Pega.
* Pega Lead System Architect certification, or equivalent experience as an LSA across multiple Pega projects with at least Pega CSSA certification.
* Extensive experience across analysis, design, development and deployment of large-scale enterprise applications.
* Deep knowledge of Pega Platform architecture and Case Management, including class design and inheritance, rule resolution, rulesets, case types, flows, assignments, SLAs, routing, data transforms and decision rules.

**Pega Cloud & Constellation:**

* Working experience with Pega Cloud or a strong understanding of cloud architecture.
* Hands-on architecture experience with Pega Constellation.
* Ability to make architecture decisions across application, integration, security, deployment and environment boundaries.

**Integration & Data Architecture:**

* Strong Pega integration experience using REST and API-based patterns, authentication, synchronous and asynchronous processing and background processing.
* Strong knowledge of data objects, data pages, system-of-record integration, persistence, caching and efficient data access patterns.

**Security & Performance:**

* Strong understanding of Pega security architecture, including authentication, SSO, OAuth/OIDC, access groups, roles, privileges and access controls.
* Experience architecting for performance, scalability, high availability, resiliency, recoverability and observability.
* Practical experience using Pega performance and diagnostic tooling.

**DevOps & Engineering:**

* Strong experience with Pega DevOps and release engineering, including CI/CD, automated quality checks, testing strategy and deployment governance.
* Experience with Pega Deployment Manager is desirable.
* Ability to assess Pega applications for guardrail compliance, technical debt, upgrade readiness and architectural risk.

**Leadership & Collaboration:**

* Strong technical leadership with the ability to conduct architecture, design and code reviews.
* Ability to resolve complex technical issues and influence architecture decisions.
* Experience coaching Senior System Architects and System Architects.
* Ability to communicate solution architecture, integration and data designs, non-functional requirements and technical roadmaps to engineering and senior stakeholders.
* Certification or practical experience in Agile methods.

**Added Advantage:**

* Experience with Pega frameworks such as KYC/CLM, Smart Disputes/Investigate, Customer Service or AIM.

**Education Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer Science/Information Technology.

title: Salesforce Engineer
description:
Welcome to Natus Sensory India
  
We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!
  
  
Natus Sensory India are a leading manufacturer of medical devices and software for a range of solutions, including eight sensory nervous systems. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes in target markets through innovative screening, diagnostic and treatment solutions. We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways.
  
  
**SUMMARY:**  
Natus Sensory is seeking a Salesforce Engineer to own the end-to-end architecture, design, and technical governance of our Salesforce platform. This role is responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and CPQ, along with integration touchpoints across our broader enterprise systems, including our ERP platform.
  
**This is not a design-only role:** he is also expected to personally implement enhancements and serve as the top-tier escalation point when issues arise, rolling up their sleeves to resolve urgent production, integration, and CPQ problems directly. The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on architecture experience across the full Salesforce platform lifecycle -- from data model and security design through integration architecture, hands-on build, and release governance -- and can operate independently as the primary technical authority for Salesforce within the organization. This person will partner closely with the business-side Salesforce admin team, the broader IT organization, and the Natus Neuro IT team (TSA partner) on shared systems.
  
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Salesforce Platform Architecture & Strategy (25%)
  

* Own the overall Salesforce architecture strategy, including org structure, data model, sharing/security model, and platform scalability roadmap
* Translate business requirements from Sales, Service, and Operations stakeholders into scalable, well-governed technical designs
* Define and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and best practices across Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative automation (Flow)
* Evaluate new Salesforce releases, features, and AppExchange products; recommend adoption where it advances the roadmap
* Lead architectural review of major enhancements, custom development, and third-party package implementations
* Maintain a multi-year Salesforce technical roadmap aligned with business strategy

Integration Architecture (20%)
  

* Design and govern integration architecture between Salesforce and enterprise systems, including ERP (Oracle EBS or similar), Microsoft 365, and other business systems
* Architect and oversee middleware/integration platform usage (MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS) for real-time and batch integrations
* Define API strategy, data synchronization patterns, and error-handling/monitoring standards across integrations
* Partner with ERP, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure integration reliability and data integrity across systems
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex, cross-system integration issues

Enhancement Implementation & Hands-On Development (15%)
  

* Personally build and deploy approved enhancements -- including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow automation, and configuration -- rather than handing designs off exclusively to others
* Own delivery of enhancement projects end-to-end: requirements, build, testing, and release, balancing scope, quality, and timeline
* Partner with the business-side Salesforce admin team to convert approved designs into working, tested solutions in the org
* Write and maintain clean, well-documented, testable code and configuration that other admins/developers can support

CPQ & Quote-to-Cash Architecture (10%)
  

* Architect and maintain Salesforce CPQ configuration, including product catalog, pricing rules, approval workflows, and quote templates
* Design quote-to-cash process flows in partnership with Sales Operations and Finance
* Ensure CPQ architecture scales with evolving product lines, pricing models, and channel strategies
* Troubleshoot CPQ configuration issues and guide the business admin team on best practices

Data Architecture, Security & Governance (15%)
  

* Design and maintain the Salesforce data model, including object relationships, record types, and data lifecycle management
* Define and enforce security architecture: profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field-level security
* Establish data governance standards, including deduplication, data quality rules, and archiving/retention policies
* Support compliance and audit activities related to Salesforce access, data handling, and change management
* Administer and govern DevOps/release management tooling (e.g., Salesforce DX, Gearset, Copado, or similar) and sandbox strategy

Production Support & Escalations (10%)
  

* Serve as the top-tier escalation point for complex Salesforce, integration, and CPQ issues that the business admin team cannot resolve
* Roll up sleeves to directly troubleshoot and resolve urgent, business-impacting production issues rather than deferring to others
* Triage and drive resolution of production incidents, coordinating with IT and business stakeholders as needed
* Maintain and improve runbooks and troubleshooting documentation based on recurring escalations
* Be responsive and available for critical, time-sensitive support needs outside of standard change requests

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management (5%)
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for all Salesforce architecture decisions
* Liaise with the Natus Neuro IT team (TSA partner) on shared Salesforce systems, integrations, and escalated issues
* Mentor administrators and junior developers on platform best practices
* Communicate technical roadmaps, trade-offs, and risks clearly to non-technical stakeholders and leadership

**Travel Required:** Minimal; occasional travel for planning sessions or team meetings may be requested.
  
  
**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:**  

* Willingness to personally build and deploy enhancements, not just design and hand off to others
* 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including 3+ years in an architect-level role
* Demonstrated experience architecting solutions across Sales Cloud and Revenue Cloud
* Hands-on experience architecting and supporting Salesforce CPQ (product catalog, pricing, approvals, quote-to-cash)
* Proven experience designing and governing integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems (ERP, middleware/iPaaS such as MuleSoft)
* Strong command of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce declarative tools (Flow)
* Experience with Salesforce DevOps/release management practices and tools (Salesforce DX, version control, CI/CD pipelines)
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, scalable technical architecture
* Comfortable serving as a top-tier escalation point for urgent, complex issues and rolling up sleeves to resolve them directly
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to present architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Self-starter mentality: able to independently own architecture decisions and production issues with minimal oversight
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of up to 30 days preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or actively pursuing the CTA credential
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect and/or System Architect
* Additional certifications: Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Platform Developer II
* Experience in a medical device, life sciences, or other regulated industry environment
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA as they relate to CRM data
* Experience integrating Salesforce with Oracle EBS or comparable ERP platforms
* Experience with Health Cloud or other industry-specific Salesforce clouds

Education and/or Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience. Salesforce architect-level certifications are highly valued and may substitute for formal education.
  
What We Offer
  

* Opportunity to own and shape Salesforce architecture for a growing medical device organization
* Competitive salary, commensurate with experience, with benefits package
* Exposure to enterprise integration architecture (Salesforce, ERP, MuleSoft/iPaaS) in a regulated industry.

**Compensation and Benefits:** Along with a competitive salary and performance-based incentives, we offer a comprehensive benefits package starting from day one, including medical insurance coverage for employees and their families, gratuity as per statutory norms, and paid time off in accordance with applicable labor laws.
  
  
Join Natus Sensory today. Confidence in every Sense.
  
  
**We offer:**  

* The role will start as a work-from-home remote position but will turn into a physical presence in an office role in Bangalore.
* Minimal travelling: less than 5%
* Collaborative and international environment with different cultures.
* English company language.
* Full ownership of testing of features and functionality.

EEO Statement
  
Natus Sensory is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

**Role : Solution Architect**

**Experience:** 8+ Years

**Location:** Bengaluru (Hybrid)

**Type:** Full-time

**About Digit88**

Digit88 is an AI-native product engineering partner helping startups and enterprises build, scale and operate intelligent software products.

We are a lean, high-impact team of 75+ technologists, backed by leaders with deep experience across startups and global enterprises. We build strong, outcome-driven engineering teams that solve complex, real-world problems.

From GenAI applications and data platforms to enterprise-grade SaaS, we deliver scalable, reliable, production-ready systems. Our expertise spans AI/ML, RAG systems, agentic workflows and large-scale data engineering - enabling businesses to move from idea to production with speed and confidence.

Our teams operate as a true extension of our clients, with full ownership and flexible engagement models focused on measurable business outcomes - not just delivery.

With 80+ AI implementations and proven success in scaling dedicated teams and driving significant cost efficiencies, we partner for long-term impact.

We bring experience across B2B and B2C SaaS, web and mobile platforms, e-commerce and domains such as Conversational AI, HealthTech, IoT, ESG/Energy, and Data Engineering - thriving in fast-paced, high-ownership environments.

**The Vision:**

To be the most trusted AI-native product engineering partner for innovative software companies worldwide, delivering ownership, speed, and measurable outcomes.

**Job Profile:**

Digit88 is seeking a Solution Architect to act as the design authority for enterprise customer implementations. You will translate business objectives into scalable solution designs and provide technical governance from discovery through go-live.

In this role you will shape the technical approach, resolve cross-system decisions and ensure that customer requirements can be delivered without compromising platform integrity. The role is customer-facing, pragmatic and accountable for technical readiness rather than slideware alone.

This role sits at the heart of our Conversational AI practice. Our customers are consumer-facing brands running contact center and digital engagement at scale, and they will look to you as the subject-matter expert on how Conversational AI is designed, integrated and operated in production.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead technical discovery and convert business outcomes into architecture, integration and non-functional requirements.
* Act as the customer-facing subject-matter expert on Conversational AI and CCaaS, building credibility with customer stakeholders from day one.
* Architect Conversational AI solutions across voice, messaging and digital channels using ElevenLabs, OpenAI and Strands.
* Design multimodal and multithreaded interaction flows that hold up on latency, concurrency and state management at production scale.
* Define solution boundaries, data flows, security patterns, environments and integration approaches.
* Define integration patterns between Java/Spring Boot backend services and Python-based AI/MLOps modules on AWS.
* Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, interface contracts and implementation guardrails.
* Review technical designs and critical changes; identify risks before they reach testing or production.
* Formulate multi-option solution blueprints that clearly detail trade-offs, implementation complexity and strategic alignment.
* Guide Customer Engineers and Product Engineers through difficult tradeoffs and escalations.
* Maintain technical governance across concurrent implementations and reusable product patterns.
* Own architecture and technical approval, delegating implementation execution to Customer Engineers while remaining available for reviews and escalations.
* Partner with Product Engineering on reusable capabilities, without committing roadmap scope outside product approval.

**What success looks like:**

* Solutions are technically feasible, scalable, secure and supportable before implementation begins.
* Material design decisions are documented and understood by customer and internal teams.
* Integration and non-functional risks surfaced early, with credible mitigation plans.
* Measured by solution quality, technical readiness, design rework, production stability and stakeholder confidence.

**Requirements:**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 8+ years in enterprise software delivery, including 3+ years in solution or integration architecture.
* Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering Conversational AI solutions in production.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, required for all client-facing and backend work.
* Strong hands-on proficiency in Python, required for all AI and MLOps work.
* Hands-on experience architecting on AWS with DynamoDB and PostgreSQL; working familiarity with React-based frontends.
* Experience integrating LLMs (e.g., OpenAI) and Voice AI platforms (e.g., ElevenLabs) into production systems.
* Experience designing multimodal (voice, text, digital) and multithreaded/concurrent systems.
* Deep experience with APIs, event-driven integration, identity, cloud architecture, data design and production operations.
* Strong command of security patterns, environment strategy and non-functional requirements across enterprise deployments.
* Ability to lead customer workshops and explain complex decisions to executives and engineers.
* Track record designing systems that moved successfully from discovery into production.

**Good to have:**

* Hands-on experience with consumer-facing CCaaS tools (Messaging, Digital AI and/or Voice AI). This is a huge advantage, as it lets you get hands-on immediately and be seen as an SME by customers.
* Experience with Strands Agents or similar agentic decision-making frameworks.
* Salesforce, Genesys Cloud or enterprise CX architecture experience.
* AI system design covering retrieval, model evaluation, guardrails, observability and human escalation.
* Experience in security-sensitive or regulated environments.

**Benefits working @ Digit88:**

* Comprehensive Insurance (Life, Health, Accident).
* Flexible Work Model.
* Accelerated learning & non-linear growth.
* Flat organization structure driven by ownership and accountability.
* Opportunity to own and be a part of some of the most innovative and promising AI/SaaS product companies in North America and around the world.
* Accomplished Global Peers - Working with some of the best engineers/professionals globally from the likes of Apple, Amazon, IBM Research, Adobe and other innovative product companies.
* Ability to make a global impact with your work, leading innovations in Conversational AI, Energy/Utilities, ESG, HealthTech, IoT, Risk/Compliance, CyberSecurity, PLM and more.

You will work with a founding team of serial entrepreneurs with multiple successful exits to their credit. The learning will be immense just as will the challenges.

**This is the right time to join us and partner in our growth**

title: Sr Security Architect II(XDR - Endpoint Security)
description:
Category: Digital & IT

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Department:** Cyber Defence Center (CDC), STO-XDR, Global Business Services

**Location:** Bengaluru, India

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Senior Security Architect II (XDR - Endpoint Security), you will own the architecture that protects every Novo device and the threat detection built on it. You will set the vision, standards and roadmap for XDR and endpoint security, turning business and operational needs into designs that hold up as Novo grows into new regions. Your work helps the Cyber Defence Center see threats sooner and respond faster, so the business can operate safely.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You combine deep endpoint security expertise with the judgement to balance strong security with what the business needs.

* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration or a related field (BE, MSc, MBA or similar).
* 12+ years of IT experience, including security, operation, project and services , project management and service management roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in EDR/XDR and endpoint protection, including Microsoft Defender XDR and Trellix Endpoint Security(EPO, HX, EDR-F).
* Experience with application control and whitelisting, attack surface reduction, endpoint hardening and vulnerability management.
* 5–8 years of experience working with GxP requirements, validation and compliance, and in-depth knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and change management.
* Experience from large, cross-geographical projects and the ability to present complex topics clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
* A structured, self-driven way of working, with an end-to-end mindset and comfort collaborating across cultures and time zones.
  

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Trend Micro Portable Security or cloud and SaaS security posture management.
* Exposure to cloud security and cloud migrations.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma or Agile frameworks.
  

**What you’ll do**

* You will make architecture decisions within your governance area and stay close to how the services run day to day. You will:
* Define and evolve the architecture, strategy and roadmap for XDR and endpoint security, in line with Novo’s enterprise cybersecurity strategy.
* Set standards, reference architectures, guardrails and security baselines for Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Trellix and Trend Micro Portable Security, including Trellix policy architecture and modernisation.
* Assess emerging technologies through PoCs, product evaluations and gap analyses, and recommend what to adopt and when.
* Drive a security-by-design approach: assess exceptions, exclusions and whitelisting requests, and find secure, sustainable alternatives wherever possible.
* Oversee service health, coverage and compliance, from agent health and policy deployment to exposure data and malware detections, and coordinate remediation with technical teams.
* Support incident response with endpoint telemetry and evidence for Threat Operations, and keep services audit-ready through strong lifecycle management, documentation and vendor coordination.
* Support end-user issues, including—but not exclusively—those related to performance, false-positive troubleshooting, and software conflicts.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

* You will join STO-XDR within the Cyber Defence Center, Novo’s dedicated cyber defence organisation. The CDC protects the company from cyber threats, detects incidents, responds quickly and hardens technologies, processes and systems so the business can operate safely. STO-XDR runs and sustains the security technology stack: managing day-to-day platform operations, upgrades and vendor relationships, ensuring logs and telemetry flow into the CDC ecosystem, and keeping platforms audit-ready and supported to agreed SLAs.
* Your closest partners will be CDC units in Denmark and India, CDC management and the CISO organisation. You will also work with Defence Engineering, Threat Operations, Digital Workplace, Infrastructure, Enterprise IT, and IT service, system and quality managers across the business. Externally, you will work with strategic suppliers including Microsoft, Trellix, Carbon Black and Wiz.
* You will bring different perspectives together, influence stakeholders with differing interests and speak up when things stall, so endpoint security stays consistent as services expand across the enterprise.
  

**What you can expect here**

* You will be trusted to work independently, own architectural decisions and set direction with significant impact across a wide, international and cross-functional area. You will have room to test new technologies and keep improving how Novo protects its endpoints.
* You will grow through global collaboration, close work with leading security vendors and the chance to mentor colleagues and train service desk and technical teams. The work moves at pace, with clear expectations and a team that values curiosity, honest feedback and quality.
  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to shape the endpoint security that keeps Novo protected, apply for the Senior Security Architect II (XDR - Endpoint Security) role by 27 oct 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

* Hands-on expertise with Azure DevOps (pipelines, YAML, release management).

* Strong background across classic infrastructure: Windows Server, Linux/Unix, VMware virtualization, enterprise databases (SQL/Oracle or similar), storage & backup platforms (NetApp, Veeam, Commvault, etc.), and enterprise networking.

* Strong hands-on experience with Azure IAM — RBAC, Conditional Access, PIM, Entra ID (Azure AD) automation and governance.

* Proven experience with SCCM for endpoint management, patching, and OS/application deployment automation.

* Experience with monitoring/observability tools (SCOM, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, or similar) and integrating automated remediation.

* Architect-level expertise in Azure, AWS, or GCP — able to design landing zones, account/subscription hierarchies, network topology, and security/governance baselines, not just automate within an existing environment.

* Working knowledge of at least one additional public cloud beyond the primary and cloud-native DevOps tooling.

description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Sr. Manager; Software Engineering leads a team responsible for reviewing business requirements and developing functional and technical design documentation. This role oversees the design and implementation of testing procedures for APIs, abstractions, and integration patterns to address distributed computing challenges, including end-to-end and integration testing. The Sr. Manager participates in design reviews, providing input on requirements, product designs, schedules, and potential issues, and works across the team to ensure productivity, predictability, and delivery of high-quality results.

The position includes accountability for code review and the team’s development and testing activities, as well as participation in proof of concepts and technical evaluations of new technologies. The Sr. Manager is expected to foster a collaborative environment, ensuring the team meets business needs and delivers robust solutions.

All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Essential Functions:

People Leadership & Talent Development:

* Hire, retain, and develop a diverse, high-performing team of software engineers across the Bangalore hub.
* Own performance management, career growth, and promotion pipelines; deliver concrete coaching and mentoring to grow engineers into senior/staff roles.
* Build a healthy, inclusive team culture with strong engagement and retention signals.

Delivery & Execution Management:

* Own end-to-end delivery for a product area — planning, prioritization, risk management, and predictable execution against roadmap commitments.
* Drive operational excellence: incident ownership, on-call health, code quality, and reduction of technical debt.
* Manage multiple competing initiatives and timelines, balancing scope, speed, and quality.
* Establish and track delivery metrics (on-time delivery, uptime, throughput, defect rates) and report progress to stakeholders.

Technical Credibility & Hands-On Engagement:

* Stay close enough to the technology to review code and designs, unblock engineers, and make sound technical calls — capable of going hands-on when needed.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews; provide informed technical judgment on trade-offs.
* Guide troubleshooting, defect triage, and root-cause analysis for critical issues.

GenAI/LLM Leadership:

* Champion the adoption of GenAI and modern engineering tooling within the team, driving practical, production use cases.
* Stay technically literate in GenAI/LLM concepts and evaluate opportunities to apply them to the product area.
* Partner with engineers building GenAI-enabled features; support experimentation while ensuring production rigor.

System Design & Architecture Judgment:

* Guide the team's architecture and technical direction for the product area, ensuring scalability, security, and resilience.
* Evaluate build-vs-buy and technology choices; set standards for APIs, microservices, and integration patterns (HTTP, REST, JSON, XML).
* Partner with architects and other engineering leaders to align designs with platform-wide standards.

Stakeholder & Organizational Influence:

* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, QA, DevOps, and global engineering teams to deliver complete solutions.
* Partner with business stakeholders on requirements, workflow design, and process re-engineering.
* Represent the team in cross-org planning and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to leadership.
* Collaborate across global, distributed teams and time zones to ensure alignment and consistent delivery standards.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Preferred Qualifications:

* 12 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 10 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree, or 7 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* Proven experience leading and growing engineering teams — hiring, coaching, performance management, and driving retention.
* Track record of delivering a product area predictably, with metrics for on-time delivery, quality, and operational health.
* Hands-on coding experience in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#, Node.js), with the depth to review code and engage in technical discussions.
* Expertise with container and cloud technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, or Splunk).
* Experience championing or driving adoption of GenAI/LLM technologies within an engineering team.
* Experience building and guiding teams that build microservices using HTTP, REST, JSON, and XML.
* Experience guiding system design and architecture decisions for a product or platform area.
* Experience managing incidents, production support, and operational excellence practices.
* Experience partnering with product, QA, DevOps, and Agile/Scrum teams in a distributed, global engineering organization.
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical and business trade-offs to diverse stakeholders.
* Payment industry experience is highly desirable.

The Skills You Bring:

* Energy and Experience: A growth mindset that is curious and passionate about technology, and enjoys leading teams on challenging, global-scale projects.
* People-First Leadership: A genuine investment in developing engineers, with a track record of promotions, mentoring, and healthy team retention.
* Technical Credibility: Comfortable enough with the technology to review designs and code, and to earn the trust of senior engineers.
* Learner: A drive to stay current on emerging technologies such as GenAI, Kubernetes, Docker, and modern cloud-native patterns.
* Partnership: Experience collaborating with Product, Test, DevOps, and Agile/Scrum teams to deliver outcomes, not just output.
* Execution Discipline: Ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deliver predictably in a fast-paced environment.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: SENIOR TECHNICAL LEAD
description:
**SENIOR TECHNICAL DEVELOPER**

**AI-led Java Modernisation | GKE on Google Cloud**

**Role Type**
  
Hands-on Senior Individual Contributor

**Experience**
  
10-18 years

**Location**
  
India - Hybrid / Remote, subject to program needs

  

**Preferred Domain**
  
Airline, Travel or GDS

**Target Platform**
  
GKE on Google Cloud Platform

**Employment Type**
  
Full-time / Program Assignment

**Role Purpose**
================

**We are seeking a highly capable, hands-on Senior Technical Developer to contribute to a large-scale technology modernisation programme.** The role requires deep Java/J2EE engineering expertise, strong cloud-native development skills, and the ability to use both AI-assisted tools and AI-agentic engineering approaches to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, compliance, maintainability or operational resilience.

The successful candidate will work with minimal supervision, take end-to-end ownership of assigned outcomes, and contribute across analysis, design, build, testing, deployment and production-readiness activities. Prior experience in airline, travel or GDS platforms is strongly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Hands-on Software Engineering**
---------------------------------

� Design, develop, test and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java, J2EE, Spring Boot and related frameworks.

� Build secure, scalable and resilient microservices, REST APIs and event-driven components.

� Apply clean-code, SOLID, domain-driven design and twelve-factor application principles.

� Produce maintainable, testable and production-ready code with appropriate technical documentation.

� Perform code reviews, troubleshoot complex issues, optimise performance and reduce technical debt.

**Modernisation Delivery**
--------------------------

� Analyse and reverse engineer legacy applications, interfaces, data flows and business rules.

� Translate legacy functionality into modern service boundaries, APIs and cloud-native implementation patterns.

� Contribute to solution design, decomposition, dependency analysis, migration planning and cutover readiness.

� Create reusable engineering accelerators, templates and reference implementations for modernisation squads.

**GCP and GKE Engineering**
---------------------------

� Develop, containerise and deploy workloads on Google Kubernetes Engine within Google Cloud Platform.

� Work with Docker, Kubernetes manifests or Helm, configuration management, secrets, service accounts, ingress and workload identity.

� Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, observability, logging, monitoring and production support.

� Engineer for reliability, scalability, fault tolerance, cost awareness and operational supportability.

**Security, Risk and Compliance**
---------------------------------

� Apply secure-by-design and privacy-by-design practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

� Follow OWASP guidance, secure coding standards, least-privilege access, secrets management, encryption and API security practices.

� Remediate vulnerabilities identified through SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, container scanning and penetration testing.

� Maintain traceability and evidence required for enterprise governance, audit, change management and regulatory compliance.

� Ensure AI-generated outputs are reviewed, validated and handled in accordance with data classification, intellectual-property and responsible-AI policies.

**Ownership and Collaboration**
-------------------------------

� Work independently with minimal supervision while proactively escalating risks, decisions and dependencies.

� Collaborate with architects, product owners, domain SMEs, platform teams, security teams, testers and SRE/operations teams.

� Mentor engineers, promote engineering standards and contribute constructively to design and code reviews.

� Demonstrate accountability for committed outcomes, quality, timelines and production readiness.

**AI-related Skill Requirements**
=================================

Candidates should demonstrate practical capability in both AI-assisted engineering and AI-agentic engineering. Tool familiarity alone is not sufficient; the candidate must be able to apply these capabilities responsibly within an enterprise delivery environment.

**Skill Area**

**Expected Capabilities**

**Indicative Evidence / Tools**

**AI-assisted software engineering**

Use generative-AI coding assistants for code completion, explanation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, defect analysis and developer productivity. Validate outputs against requirements, coding standards and architecture constraints.

GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, IDE-integrated assistants or equivalent.

  

**Prompt and context engineering**

Create precise prompts, task instructions, examples, constraints and acceptance criteria. Select and structure relevant artefacts so that AI outputs are grounded in approved program knowledge.

Prompt patterns, reusable instruction files, context packs, coding standards, architecture guidance and domain glossaries.

  

**AI-agent configuration**

Configure specialised agents with defined roles, goals, tools, workflow steps, guardrails, memory boundaries, escalation rules and output formats.

Agent definitions, system instructions, tool permissions, workflow orchestration, human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

  

**Agent skills and reusable capabilities**

Create or configure reusable agent skills for reverse engineering, design support, story elaboration, code generation, testing, review, documentation and troubleshooting.

Skill files, templates, procedures, tool adapters, validation rules and structured outputs.

  

**Knowledge-context management**

Curate and maintain trusted knowledge contexts drawn from requirements, legacy code, design documents, API specifications, coding standards, test assets and operational documentation.

Repository-based context, indexed documentation, retrieval workflows, metadata, versioning and access controls.

  

**Agentic SDLC execution**

Use coordinated agents across multiple SDLC steps while preserving traceability, deterministic quality gates and human accountability.

Multi-step workflows for analysis-to-code, code-to-test, review, defect remediation and documentation.

  

**AI output evaluation and quality control**

Assess accuracy, completeness, security, hallucination risk, code quality, test adequacy and alignment with architecture. Define feedback loops and measurable acceptance thresholds.

Golden datasets, benchmark tasks, review checklists, automated validations, regression testing and quality metrics.

  

**Responsible and secure AI use**

Protect confidential information, prevent unauthorised data exposure, respect licensing/IP constraints, and comply with enterprise AI governance and model-use policies.

Data classification, approved models, access controls, audit logs, prompt/output handling standards and responsible-AI controls.

  

**AI-enabled delivery acceleration**

Demonstrate measurable improvements in cycle time, engineering throughput, defect prevention or documentation quality without weakening controls.

Productivity metrics, reuse assets, reduced rework, improved coverage and evidence-based delivery outcomes.

**Required Technical Skills**
=============================

**Java and Application Engineering:** Java 11/17 or later; J2EE/Jakarta EE; Spring Boot; Spring Framework; Spring Data/JPA; Hibernate; REST/JSON/XML; Maven or Gradle; unit and integration testing.

**Architecture and Integration:** Microservices; API-first design; event-driven architecture; distributed systems; resilience patterns; domain-driven design; synchronous and asynchronous integration.

**Cloud, Containers and DevOps:** Google Cloud Platform; GKE; Docker; Kubernetes; Helm or equivalent; Git; CI/CD; infrastructure/configuration awareness; logging, monitoring and observability.

**Data Engineering:** Strong SQL; relational databases such as Oracle or PostgreSQL; schema design; query optimisation; transaction management; exposure to NoSQL or messaging platforms is advantageous.

**Engineering Quality:** Test automation; code coverage; static analysis; dependency management; performance engineering; peer review; production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

**Security and Compliance:** OWASP Top 10; secure coding; IAM; secrets management; encryption; API security; vulnerability remediation; DevSecOps controls; audit and change-management discipline.

**Preferred Airline / Travel Domain Experience**
================================================

� Passenger service, reservations, ticketing, pricing, check-in, departure control, loyalty, revenue management or airline operations.

� GDS, distribution, interline, codeshare, NDC or airline partner integrations.

� Modernisation of high-volume, mission-critical legacy airline platforms and interfaces.

� Understanding of availability, reliability, data integrity and operational continuity expectations within airline systems.

**Behavioural Competencies**
============================

**Competency**

**Expected Behaviour**

**Ownership**

Takes end-to-end responsibility and follows through until outcomes are achieved.

  

**Independence**

Operates effectively with minimal supervision and seeks guidance only where decisions materially require it.

  

**Problem solving**

Breaks down ambiguity, diagnoses complex issues and makes evidence-based technical decisions.

  

**Communication**

Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders; raises risks early.

  

**Collaboration**

Works constructively across architecture, product, domain, security, testing and platform teams.

  

**Learning agility**

Adopts new tools, AI practices and modern engineering patterns rapidly and responsibly.

  

**Quality mindset**

Balances delivery speed with security, maintainability, testing and operational resilience.

**Qualifications**
==================

� Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

� Relevant Java, GCP, Kubernetes or cloud-native certifications are desirable but not mandatory.

� Demonstrable hands-on engineering capability and delivery outcomes will be weighted more strongly than certification alone.

**Measures of Success**
=======================

**Outcome Area**

**Success Measure**

**Delivery**

Consistently completes committed outcomes with limited supervision and transparent risk management.

  

**Engineering quality**

Produces secure, maintainable, well-tested code with low defect leakage and manageable technical debt.

  

**AI-enabled productivity**

Uses AI-assisted and agentic practices to demonstrate measurable cycle-time, quality or throughput improvements.

  

**Modernisation**

Successfully translates legacy capabilities into scalable, supportable cloud-native services.

  

**Security and compliance**

Meets required security controls, evidence standards, governance gates and remediation timelines.

  

**Cloud readiness**

Deploys and supports reliable workloads on GKE/GCP with appropriate observability and operational controls.

  

**Reuse and capability building**

Creates reusable prompts, skills, agent configurations, engineering assets and patterns that improve squad performance.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
===========================

The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who remains deeply hands-on, understands enterprise Java and cloud-native engineering, and treats AI as an engineering capability rather than merely a productivity tool. The candidate can configure AI agents, reusable skills and trusted knowledge contexts; evaluate AI-generated outputs rigorously; and apply these methods to accelerate modernisation delivery while maintaining security, compliance, quality and human accountability.

**Assumptions Used in Preparing This**
======================================

� The target experience range is 10-18 years; this may be adjusted based on internal grade architecture.

� The modernisation programme uses Java/Spring-based microservices deployed to GKE on GCP.

� AI tools and models will be restricted to enterprise-approved platforms, repositories and data-handling policies.

� Airline domain experience is preferred, not mandatory, unless the role is assigned to a highly specialised functional area.

� The employer will insert company-specific information such as location, reporting line, equal-opportunity statement, benefits and application process before external publication.

We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Senior Manager - AI & IT

### **What You Will Be Doing**

ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. This role owns cloud identity, directory services, Okta identity workflows, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML). You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.  
  
**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* Lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture, encompassing cloud identity, directory services, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).
* Define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
* Establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows.
* Build and implement advanced identity security controls such as Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and risk-based authentication.
* Scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations. Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
* Drive IAM application development: code, design, and implement solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Deliver reliable solutions that keep engineering teams productive.
* Drive IAM projects end-to-end: take ambiguous access problems, define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout and operationalization — not just the design.
* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and machine identity security.
* Experience implementing AI/Agentic security controls and secure automation frameworks.
* Platform experience: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Cloud Secrets Manager, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, container security platforms.

title: Guidewire Architect
description:

Professional Services/Full time/Onsite

Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI-enabled delivery. We work as one global team, combining deep product expertise, implementation excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement to help customers realize value faster. Our environment is collaborative, customer-obsessed, and innovation-driven, centered on Guidewire InsuranceSuite and the Guidewire Cloud Platform.
  
  
As a Guidewire Architect focused on PolicyCenter, you will define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for complex, often greenfield implementations across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead critical design decisions, and ensure solutions meet demanding performance, scalability, and security needs.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers’ path to value while contributing to Professional Services’ mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Define and own the technical architecture, design standards, and implementation roadmap for Guidewire PolicyCenter across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid deployments, aligning with customer enterprise architectures and Guidewire best practices.
* Lead end-to-end PolicyCenter configuration and customization, including Gosu development, PCF/UI design, data model extensions, underwriting rules, workflows, and plugins, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to business needs.
* Architect and oversee complex integrations between PolicyCenter and enterprise systems (billing, CRM, data warehouses, external partners, document management, and third-party services) using APIs, web services, and messaging patterns.
* Provide day-to-day technical leadership for cross-functional delivery teams, performing architecture and code reviews, mentoring senior developers and integrators, and driving engineering excellence and high test coverage (including GUnit).
* Collaborate closely with business analysts and customer stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable architectures and non-functional designs covering performance, availability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Champion Professional Services priorities by leveraging AI and automation to reduce implementation effort and time, support cloud migration and adoption, and help industrialize repeatable, high-quality delivery patterns across projects.
* Contribute to organizational assets such as accelerators, reference architectures, and technical white papers, and lead knowledge-sharing to uplift Guidewire and partner teams globally.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

**Required**

* 10–18 years of hands-on experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter, including at least two greenfield PolicyCenter implementations.
* Guidewire Certified ACE for PolicyCenter Configuration, with deep knowledge of PolicyCenter UI, data model, Studio, and out-of-the-box features and accelerators.
* Strong experience with Gosu, PCF, entities, typelists, rules, workflows, plugins, and configuration for new personal and commercial lines of business.
* Proven track record architecting and delivering complex integrations using RESTful APIs, web services, messaging, and related technologies (e.g., Apache Camel, Bitbucket, IntelliJ).
* Solid understanding of object-oriented design principles, performance optimization, security best practices, and non-functional requirements design for mission-critical systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to work in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Flexibility to collaborate across time zones and shifts when needed to support customers and global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience with Guidewire Cloud (PolicyCenter on Guidewire Cloud Platform), including cloud-native patterns, observability, and CI/CD practices.
* Background leading architecture on multiple PolicyCenter cloud or upgrade programs, especially those leveraging AI-enabled tools or automation to reduce implementation effort.
* Familiarity with other Guidewire products (ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, Analytics, or Data Platform) and with modern microservices or event-driven architectures.
* BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

**Your Impact**
---------------

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take architectural ownership of one or more complex PolicyCenter implementations, aligning solution designs with customer business objectives while embedding Professional Services’ priorities around AI-enabled, faster, and more predictable delivery.

  
  

You will define technical roadmaps, guide teams through critical design and integration decisions, and put in place patterns and assets that measurably reduce implementation effort and time for future projects. As your influence grows, you will help customers fully leverage Guidewire’s cloud and AI platform, directly supporting our wider mission to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business and advancing Guidewire’s ambition to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions globally.

  
  

**What’s in it for you**
  
The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:
  
Flexible work environment.
  
Health and wellness benefits.
  
Paid time off programs including volunteer time off.
  
Market‑competitive pay and incentive programs.
  
Continual development and internal career growth opportunities.
  
  
All roles at Guidewire include an in‑person interview experience, and we provide an in‑person orientation for all new hires to help you build relationships and understand how your work contributes to our customers and mission.

Interested in this position?

  

**About Guidewire**

  
  

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

  
  

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

  
  

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.

title: Associate - Digital Delivery - T&I
description:
WSP are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead to drive digital transformation, BIM excellence, automation initiatives, and digital project delivery across our Transport & Infrastructure business.

The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.

You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.

  

**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

**1. Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance**

* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching **Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP)** and **BIM Execution Plans (BEP)** in strict compliance with **ISO 19650** standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the **Common Data Environment (CDE)** using **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)** / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.

**2. GIS & Digital Twin Integration**

* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting **GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS)** with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational **Digital Twin environments** (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future **IoT sensor data metadata placeholders** within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.

**3. CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows**

* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.

title: Performance Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

**All about the role**

As Performance Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager.

The Performance Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecycle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner.

You'll own how we prove that our consumer platforms perform at scale: from understanding how customers really use our systems, through designing realistic load and performance tests, to finding bottlenecks and seeing the fixes through. This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way.

**About the CDI Experience Organization**

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI.

At CDI XO, Electrolux Group's Consumer Direct Interaction Organization, we are transforming everyday life through digital innovation.

Our engineers help design and build solutions, big and small, to enable a range of highly connected Consumer Market solutions in a modern distributed landscape. Our new team members will be working at the cutting edge of Cloud Native technology and patterns. We strive to develop, build, deploy and run intelligently.

**What you'll do**

* Gather and analyse performance requirements and architectural dependencies with product teams, architects and business stakeholders.
* Build workload models from production evidence (observability data, gateway logs, real user monitoring) so that tests reflect how customers actually use our platforms.
* Design, develop, execute and monitor the full range of performance tests: load, stress, soak, spike and scalability, at both API and client side.
* Create and maintain performance testing frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so performance is checked continuously, not just before a release.
* Automate manual and repetitive performance testing activities, and treat test scripts, configuration and dashboards as code (no point and click).
* Analyse application, infrastructure and database performance issues, find complex bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives through to completion.

Work across a stack that includes:

* Observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor.
* Enterprise SaaS and PaaS systems in the eCommerce, Finance and Logistics arenas.
* Cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, including Kubernetes and microservices.
* Build performance dashboards, prepare reports and give clear, evidence-based updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage test environments and test data, and make the gaps between test and production environments visible.
* Work with SRE colleagues to tie performance targets to SLOs and SLIs, and use test results to protect Error Budgets.
* Identify risks and issues early, and give actionable recommendations.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps teams and business stakeholders to choose the right design solutions and make sure performance objectives are met.
* Mentor engineers in performance engineering practices, and stay current with tools and industry trends.

But…the most important thing is that you are genuinely passionate about performance engineering and continuous improvement.

**Who are you**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in performance testing and engineering.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Apache JMeter.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with BlazeMeter.
* Strong monitoring experience with Dynatrace and Datadog.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Proficiency in scripting with Java, Python and/or JavaScript.
* Strong experience automating performance testing, with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Good knowledge of SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience with client-side performance testing and performance monitoring dashboards.
* Proven ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and give optimisation recommendations.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including requirement gathering, stakeholder management and sprint-based delivery.
* Experience working with customers to understand deployment architectures and use cases.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills; self-driven, flexible and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer Science/Software Engineering related degree.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

**Desirable qualifications and experience**

* Knowledge of AWS.
* Heap dump and thread dump analysis.
* Experience with Git.
* Experience with SAP systems, particularly SAP Commerce Cloud.
* Strong understanding of Datadog RUM.

**Where you'll be**

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. Immediate joiners are preferred.

**Benefits Highlights**

* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

**About Global Delivery Services**



Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.



Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.



Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.

  


**What we offer you**
