title: Software Engineering Lead
description:
**About Airbound**
------------------

**Our mission is to make a world where everyone has access to delivery. Where goods move as freely as information moves today.**


This is possible. Today the cost of moving on a scooter is ₹2/km. That’s the cost of moving a 150kg mass from point A to B. We’re bringing that mass down to less than 5kgs, concurrently bringing the cost down to 10 paise/km. This is how we make deliveries a reality. This is how we create a world where we’re doing billions of deliveries per day.


The tech is not there. The current cost of drone delivery is ₹100/km. We need to completely redefine the way things are done here. We’re building the world’s most efficient aircraft from the ground\-up, and scaling that up to beyond anything the aerospace sector has ever seen. This cannot be an iterative process. We have to tear down all conventions and build everything up from scratch.


To do this, we need nothing less than the best engineers. The ones who care about building something fundamentally different, who are deeply curious about understanding the fundamentals of everything they’re working on, who are dreamers that believe in the impossible.

**About Flight Systems**
------------------------


The hardware on the drone is only half of what keeps it up in the air. The rest is the software both on the craft and on our ground station. Our unique dual motor thrust vectored tailsitter with blended wing body design has to fly in almost all weather\-including heavy winds and light rains autonomously. We're targeting 1000s of flights per day across all locations, requiring us to rethink everything from firmware, controls, state estimation to even ground control and fleet management software. We've achieved an industry\-leading payload\-to\-weight ratio of \~2kg drone for 1kg payload and we're pushing this even further. Every gram matters when you're revolutionizing logistics. This is where cutting\-edge aerospace engineering meets software scalability meets real\-world impact. If you get excited about solving problems that span multiple disciplines that don't have textbook solutions, this is your playground.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Engineer to join our team dedicated to developing a suite of sophisticated, web\-based platforms for UAV operations. This role is central to building the software that powers our entire ecosystem, including our next\-generation Ground Control Station (GCS), fleet management dashboards, data analysis tools, and simulation interfaces. This position is integral to our core mission, contributing directly to the safety and efficiency of our real\-world autonomous operations.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Platform Development:** Architect, develop, and deploy robust, end\-to\-end features across our various web\-based UAV platforms
* **Front\-End Engineering:** Construct dynamic and highly responsive user interfaces using React for the visualization of real\-time telemetry, interactive mission planning, and complex data analysis
* **Back\-End Engineering:** Engineer high\-throughput, low\-latency backend services using NestJS to reliably process UAV data streams, manage command\-and\-control logic, and parse specialized communication protocols
* **Full Lifecycle Ownership:** Actively participate in all phases of the agile software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance
* **Software Excellence:** Champion and adhere to software development best practices, including Test\-Driven Development (TDD), to ensure exceptional code quality, system reliability, and performance in a mission\-critical environment
* **Technical Documentation:** Create and maintain clear, concise technical documentation for the systems and features you develop, including architectural diagrams, API specifications, and operational runbooks
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work with cross\-functional teams to translate complex requirements into robust technical solutions

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Must\-Have**
--------------

* A minimum of 7\+ years of professional experience in full\-stack software development, preferably with exposure to real\-time systems
* Front\-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React, with demonstrated experience building complex, data\-driven user interfaces
* Back\-End Technologies: Advanced proficiency in backend development with Node.js and extensive hands\-on experience with the NestJS framework
* Database Systems: Hands\-on experience with both SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB) databases, including schema design and query optimization
* Networking: A strong understanding of core networking principles, including the TCP/IP suite and UDP, with practical experience implementing real\-time communication using WebSockets
* Data Stream Processing: Experience developing systems that process and manage continuous, high\-frequency data streams
* Software Engineering Fundamentals:


	+ Strong test\-driven development and profiling expertise for safety\-critical systems
	+ Mastery of Git workflows and collaborative development practices
	+ Application of SOLID principles and embedded software best practices
	+ Excellent documentation and communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Domain Knowledge: Experience with UAV software like ArduPilot, simulation environments (SITL), and communication protocols like MAVLink
* Data Visualization: Proficiency with libraries such as D3\.js, Chart.js, Mapbox, or Leaflet
* Data Pipelines: Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) or time\-series databases (e.g., InfluxDB, TimescaleDB)
* Additional Languages: Familiarity with C\+\+ or Python

**Work location:** Hoskote, Bangalore (Headquarters)

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Comprehensive health insurance** to keep you and your loved ones covered
* **Relocation assistance and a daily travel stipend** to ease your commute
* **Advanced salary credit** to support you when you need it


“A driven, passionate team where you’ll have room to grow and thrive \- **this is more than just a job, it’s a rare opportunity to build something meaningful** from the ground up”

**Work Schedule:**
------------------

* In\-office role, working alternate Saturdays.

**Ready to take off?**
======================

Strong understanding of high\-speed digital design, mixed\-signal layouts, multi\-layer stackup design, and design for manufacturing (DFM) principles
* Power Electronics Expertise:


	+ Hands\-on experience designing switch\-mode power supplies, linear regulators, battery management systems, and motor control circuits
	+ Understanding of magnetics design, thermal management, and efficiency optimization
	+ Proficiency with power simulation tools (LTspice, PLECS, or similar)
* Embedded Systems \& Integration:

	+ Knowledge of sensor integration (IMUs, GPS, barometers, cameras) and actuation systems
	+ Familiarity with embedded firmware development for hardware bring\-up and validation
* EMI/EMC \& Compliance:


	+ Practical knowledge of EMI/EMC design principles and testing methodologies
	+ Experience with relevant standards: MIL\-STD\-461, IEC 61000 series, FCC Part 15, DO\-160
	+ Understanding of shielding, filtering, grounding, and RF containment techniques
* RF Systems (Basic to Intermediate):

**We are seeking an experienced** **Senior Member of Technical Staff (Senior MTS)** **to join the NuData team in** **Bengaluru****. This individual will be a key technical contributor and hands\-on engineering leader for the local team, partnering closely with NuData architects, technical leads, and engineers in the** **U.S., China, and Ireland****.**


**In this role, you will help design and build critical capabilities across NuData’s distributed database platforms. You will own complex technical initiatives, contribute to key architectural decisions, and solve challenging problems involving scalability, availability, performance, consistency, and operational efficiency.**


**This is a** **hands\-on technical role****. You will stay deeply engaged with the technology—designing and implementing critical components, writing and reviewing production code, prototyping new approaches, debugging complex system and production issues, and working alongside engineers to solve challenging distributed\-systems problems. You will also engage directly with NuData customers to understand their workloads, address technical challenges, and ensure our platforms continue to meet their evolving needs.**


**You will also contribute to strengthening NuData’s engineering organization in Bengaluru by mentoring engineers, raising the technical bar, promoting strong engineering practices, and sharing expertise across the team.**


**What you will accomplish**
----------------------------


* **Own and drive major technical initiatives** **within NuData, contributing to the architecture and evolution of eBay’s distributed database platforms.**
* **Take end\-to\-end ownership of critical distributed database components and capabilities—from design and implementation through testing, production rollout, and ongoing operational excellence.**
* **Remain** **hands\-on with design and development****, implementing critical database components and production\-quality code while tackling complex problems across storage, transactions, replication, consensus, geo\-distribution, and high\-concurrency systems.**
* **Contribute to architectural decisions for complex technical problems, evaluating tradeoffs and developing pragmatic solutions that meet platform, customer, and business requirements.**
* **Drive improvements in scalability, latency, availability, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency across systems operating at eBay scale.**
* **Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, helping improve engineering judgment, technical skills, and overall engineering quality within the Bengaluru organization.**
* **Advocate for high standards in architecture, design, code quality, testing, observability, automation, and operational readiness. Participate in and lead design and code reviews for significant platform capabilities.**
* **Partner closely with engineers, architects, engineering leaders, product managers, and** **NuData customers** **to understand workloads, requirements, and technical challenges and translate them into effective platform solutions.**
* **Drive projects from early exploration through production—including brainstorming, prototyping, benchmarking, design, implementation, deployment, and production support.**
* **Evaluate emerging technologies and open\-source solutions and identify opportunities to improve NuData’s architecture and capabilities. Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools where they improve engineering velocity and quality.**
* **Communicate technical designs, architectural decisions, and tradeoffs clearly to engineers, architects, and engineering leadership.**

**What you will bring**
-----------------------


* **Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 10\+ years of experience or a PhD with equivalent experience building large\-scale distributed systems.**
* **Significant hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating** **large\-scale distributed databases, storage systems, or data infrastructure****, with demonstrated ownership of technically complex systems and initiatives.**

### **Core Technical Expertise**


* **Strong expertise in distributed systems and database architecture, including distributed consensus, replication, consistency models, partitioning, fault tolerance, high availability, and geo\-distributed systems.**
* **Strong understanding of database internals such as storage and buffer management, write\-ahead logging (WAL), multi\-version concurrency control (MVCC), lock management, query planning/execution, indexing, and database engines.**
* **Strong transaction\-management expertise, including isolation levels, concurrency control, deadlock detection, crash recovery, physical/logical replication, and HA/failover strategies.**
* **Strong understanding of distributed\-system failure modes, including network partitions, partial failures, consensus protocols such as** **RAFT/PAXOS****, and the tradeoffs required to maintain availability, consistency, and performance at scale.**
* **Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, operating systems, and software architecture.**
* **Advanced programming experience in one or more languages such as** **C\+\+, Java, Python, Scala****, or equivalent languages, with a track record of developing and debugging complex production systems.**
* **Extensive hands\-on experience with Object\-Oriented Design, distributed programming, and large\-scale relational and/or NoSQL database systems.**
* **Experience with modern infrastructure technologies and cloud\-native environments, including technologies such as** **Kubernetes and Docker****.**
* **Demonstrated ability to diagnose difficult production issues across software, storage, networking, and distributed\-system boundaries and drive problems through root cause and long\-term resolution.**

### **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**


* **Demonstrated ability to** **provide technical leadership for significant components and projects****, contribute to architectural direction, and make sound technical tradeoffs.**

* **Ability to operate at multiple levels—from designing systems and reviewing architecture to writing code, debugging production systems, and helping engineers solve difficult implementation problems.**

### **Global Collaboration**

title: Applications Engineering, Staff Engineer
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18845 **Date posted** 09/15/2026
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You have spent years deep in the realities of chip design, where a power integrity issue at 3nm can cost months and millions, and you have learned that the gap between a tool that works in theory and one that closes timing on a real SoC is everything. You think in terms of deployment, not demos. You know what it takes to get an EDA solution from product spec to production use at a top semiconductor company, and you care about making that path shorter and cleaner every time.


You are comfortable sitting with a customer architect who is three weeks from tapeout, diagnosing a signal integrity failure, and walking out with a plan that actually works. You do not wait for perfect documentation. You dig into the design, ask the right questions, and move. You have worked across ASIC physical design, power or signal integrity closure, or custom circuit simulation, and you understand how those worlds connect when you are trying to ship silicon that actually functions.


At Synopsys, you will work with the Ansys EDA portfolio, deploy it at companies building the most advanced chips in the world, and help shape what the tools become next.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Deploy Synopsys Ansys EDA products at top semiconductor companies working on leading\-edge SoCs and 3DICs at 7nm, 5nm, and 3nm nodes
* Work directly with global customers, IP providers, and foundries to understand design challenges around power integrity, signal integrity, reliability (EM, ESD, thermal), advanced timing, jitter, and packaging
* Collaborate with software developers, architects, and product specialists to translate customer challenges into EDA product specifications and drive product development
* Use the Ansys Seascape platform to solve big\-data design challenges across chip, package, and system levels
* Provide expert technical guidance and consultation to customers globally, helping them close power, signal, and reliability issues on real designs
* Diagnose complex design failures, reproduce issues, and work with engineering teams to deliver solutions that hold up in production
* Travel occasionally to customer sites for deployment support, technical reviews, and design problem\-solving

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable the world's leading semiconductor companies to tape out chips at 7nm, 5nm, and 3nm by solving power, signal, and reliability challenges they cannot close without your expertise
* Shape the next generation of Synopsys Ansys EDA tools by feeding real customer pain points directly into product development
* Reduce time to closure for customers facing critical design bottlenecks, turning weeks of debug into days with the right deployment and guidance
* Build long\-term technical relationships with architects and design teams at top\-tier semiconductor companies, becoming their trusted resource for advanced node challenges
* Drive adoption of the Seascape platform across the industry, proving out its value on real, complex designs
* Influence foundry and IP provider roadmaps by surfacing design trends and tool gaps you see across multiple customer engagements
* Mentor application engineers and expand the team's collective expertise in power integrity, signal integrity, and reliability at scale

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or related field, and 5\+ years of related experience, or Master's degree with 3\+ years of experience
* Hands\-on experience in ASIC physical design, power integrity/signal integrity/reliability closure, or custom circuit design and simulation
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in real customer design environments
* Solid programming skills in scripting languages like Python, Tcl, or Perl for automation and workflow development
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs clearly to customers and internal teams
* Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites for deployment and technical support
* Experience with EDA tools for power analysis, signal integrity, or reliability verification is a strong plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting with incomplete information, ask three sharp questions, and leave with a clear picture of what is actually broken and what needs to happen next
* You are comfortable context\-switching between a product development discussion in the morning and a customer debug session in the afternoon without losing the thread of either
* You push back when a product spec is too vague or a deployment plan does not account for how customers actually work, and you do it in a way that moves the conversation forward
* You do not need to be the loudest person in the room, but when you speak, people listen because you have done the work and you know what you are talking about
* You are organized enough to manage multiple customer engagements, product feedback loops, and internal projects at once without dropping details that matter
* You genuinely enjoy learning new technology and figuring out how to make it work in messy, real\-world conditions

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You will be part of the Applications Engineering team deploying Synopsys Ansys EDA products globally. The team works closely with software developers, architects, product specialists, and customers at top semiconductor companies to drive product development and deployment on leading\-edge SoCs and 3DICs. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, regional focus, and current customer engagements during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
**Role Description**
 Principal Platform Architect Who We Look For
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Principal Platform Architect** 
 to define, build, and evolve the cloud platform and internal developer platform that underpin UST FinX's engineering organization.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands\-on technical leadership role — not a people\-management position.
   

  

 Your influence will come from designing strong platform foundations, making sound architectural decisions, building production\-grade infrastructure and platform capabilities, mentoring engineers, and raising engineering standards across multiple teams.
   

  

 You will own the technical direction of our platform engineering capabilities across
 **AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, automated delivery, observability, security, reliability, and developer experience** 
 .
   

  

 The goal is not to build infrastructure independently for every project. You will create reusable platform capabilities that can support multiple products, clients, environments, and engineering teams consistently.
   

  

 You understand that a platform is itself an engineering product used by other engineers. It must be reliable, secure, observable, automated, documented, maintainable, and easy to consume.
   

  

 You remain close to implementation: reviewing architecture, building infrastructure and platform components, improving deployment automation, writing code, investigating production issues, and helping teams solve difficult operational problems.
   

  

 You understand that good platform engineering is not simply about provisioning infrastructure. It requires balancing developer autonomy with standardisation, security with usability, abstraction with transparency, and delivery speed with operational control.
   

  

 In an AI\-assisted engineering environment, you apply strong technical judgment to validate, refine, and sometimes reject generated output. Infrastructure and platform code must meet the same standards for correctness, resilience, security, maintainability, and operational safety as manually produced engineering work.
   

  

 We value a collaborative, merit\-driven engineering culture. Senior architects are expected to constructively challenge weak designs, simplify unnecessary complexity, make pragmatic technical decisions, and help the organisation converge on strong reusable engineering patterns.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Define and evolve the technical architecture of the UST FinX cloud platform and internal developer platform.
* Design and build reusable platform capabilities covering cloud foundations, runtime environments, networking, deployment, observability, security, configuration, and developer self\-service.
* Work hands\-on with AWS and Kubernetes\-based production environments.
* Establish infrastructure\-as\-code patterns that allow environments and platform capabilities to be created, changed, reviewed, tested, and reproduced safely.
* Define automated delivery and GitOps practices covering deployment, environment promotion, rollback, release controls, configuration management, and policy enforcement.
* Design platform capabilities that can be reused consistently across products, clients, environments, and engineering teams.
* Define architectural patterns for cloud networking, identity and access management, workload isolation, security boundaries, deployment models, environment strategy, scalability, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Build production\-quality platform components including reusable infrastructure modules, automation, services, libraries, templates, and reference implementations.
* Design internal developer\-platform capabilities that provide teams with clear, supported paths for building, deploying, operating, and observing applications.
* Establish self\-service workflows that reduce unnecessary dependencies on central platform teams without weakening governance or operational controls.
* Define platform standards for application deployment, configuration, secrets, observability, health management, scaling, resilience, and production readiness.
* Guide teams in designing highly available systems that tolerate infrastructure failure and support predictable recovery.
* Establish observability standards covering metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, s, service health, and reliability objectives.
* Establish platform security patterns covering identity, access control, secrets, encryption, workload isolation, network security, software supply chain, and automated security controls.
* Help engineering teams understand and manage the operational and cost consequences of architectural decisions.
* Partner with backend, frontend, data, DevOps, QA, security, product, and client\-facing teams so that the platform enables delivery rather than becoming an obstacle to it.
* Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, incident analysis, and technical direction.
* Ensure platform capabilities are deployable, observable, secure, scalable, recoverable, maintainable, and cost\-aware from the start.


 Reporting Line and Role Context
   

  

 This role reports directly to the CTO of UST FinX.
   

  

 You will operate as one of the CTO's senior technical leaders, creating engineering leverage across the organization while remaining deeply hands\-on.
   

  

 You will influence multiple engineering teams, establish reusable standards, mentor technical leaders, challenge weak designs, and turn technical direction into production\-quality execution.
   

  

 This is not a passive advisory role and not a traditional people\-management position.
   

  

 Your authority will come from technical credibility, judgment, execution, and your ability to make other engineers and teams more effective.
   

  

 You will work closely with the CTO to define technical standards, identify engineering gaps, raise delivery quality, evolve the platform architecture, and ensure that architectural direction is reflected in real infrastructure, real code, and operational behaviour.
   

  

 The objective is to act as a technical force multiplier across the engineering organization.
   

  

**Skills And Experience We Are Looking For**
* Minimum 8 years of experience across software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or architecture, ideally 10–15 years with meaningful ownership of production platforms.
* Strong experience designing and operating production cloud platforms on AWS.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture including account and environment strategy, networking, identity and access management, workload isolation, security boundaries, availability, resilience, operational controls, and cost\-aware design.
* Deep production experience with Kubernetes, including cluster architecture, workload scheduling, ingress and traffic management, autoscaling, service discovery, configuration, secrets, application lifecycle, deployment strategies, and production troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with infrastructure as code, including designing reusable infrastructure abstractions, modules, testing approaches, dependency management, and safe infrastructure evolution.
* Strong understanding of GitOps and modern CI/CD, including automated delivery, environment promotion, rollback, release controls, policy enforcement, and deployment safety.
* Experience designing and operating platforms across multiple environments, clients, products, or teams rather than infrastructure for a single application.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, including private and public connectivity, routing, load balancing, DNS, service\-to\-service communication, network isolation, and secure connectivity patterns.
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, least\-privilege access, service identities, secrets management, encryption, and security boundaries.
* Strong understanding of observability, including metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, ing, service\-level objectives, and production diagnostics.
* Strong production\-engineering experience covering reliability, scalability, recoverability, performance, security, operability, maintainability, and cost efficiency.
* Experience designing internal developer platforms, shared platform services, or reusable engineering capabilities consumed by multiple development teams.
* Strong understanding of platform\-product principles, including developer experience, self\-service, sensible defaults, supported paths, documentation, discoverability, and reducing cognitive load for delivery teams.
* Experience building reusable platform abstractions without hiding operational behaviour to the point that teams cannot understand or troubleshoot their systems.
* Experience with production incident response, root\-cause analysis, capacity problems, infrastructure failures, deployment failures, and complex operational troubleshooting.
* Strong software\-engineering capability and the ability to contribute code, automation, infrastructure modules, libraries, tools, or services rather than operating exclusively at architecture level.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain architecture decisions, trade\-offs, risks, and operational consequences clearly to globally distributed engineering teams.
* Strong mentoring capability and the ability to establish technical direction without relying on formal authority.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing and building an internal developer platform or platform product consumed by multiple engineering teams.
* Experience creating reusable engineering capabilities rather than project\-specific infrastructure.
* Experience designing cloud environments that support multiple clients, tenants, products, or organisational boundaries while maintaining appropriate isolation.
* Experience designing self\-service capabilities for environment provisioning, application deployment, configuration, operational tooling, or other recurring engineering activities.
* Experience with advanced Kubernetes networking, traffic\-management, ingress, service\-to\-service communication, and workload\-security patterns.
* Experience designing highly available and resilient distributed platforms across multiple availability zones or equivalent failure domains.
* Experience with API\-first, event\-driven, microservice, and integration\-heavy enterprise architectures.
* Strong software development experience where platform capabilities interact with backend services, APIs, automation, or shared engineering libraries.
* Experience building developer tooling, automation, command\-line utilities, portals, APIs, or other interfaces that improve developer experience.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code, automated governance, security automation, secrets management, software supply\-chain security, vulnerability management, and compliance\-oriented controls.
* Experience implementing platform observability across infrastructure and applications, including common standards for telemetry, correlation, dashboards, ing, and operational diagnostics.
* Experience designing backup, recovery, disaster\-recovery, and business\-continuity strategies for critical cloud platforms.
* Experience implementing safe deployment approaches including progressive delivery, automated rollback, health validation, and controlled environment promotion.
* Experience designing platforms for financial services, banking, payments, or other regulated environments where security, auditability, resilience, segregation, and operational control are critical.
* Experience evaluating competing platform technologies based on reliability, operational complexity, developer experience, portability, cost, ecosystem maturity, and long\-term maintainability rather than technology preference.
* Experience living with the long\-term consequences of platform architecture decisions — supporting, patching, debugging, scaling, securing, migrating, and evolving a platform after widespread organisational adoption.


**About UST FinX**
 UST FinX is a financial technology initiative within UST focused on modernizing core banking infrastructure for mid\-sized and large financial institutions.
   

  

 Backed by UST's global engineering scale and financial\-services experience, we combine product engineering, systems integration, and managed services into a unified transformation offering.
   

  

 Our approach is based on progressive modernization: allowing modern and legacy systems to coexist while institutions progressively move toward API\-driven, event\-driven, cloud\-ready banking platforms.
   

  

 We emphasize interoperability, scalability, resilience, security, strong engineering practices, and operational control.
   

  

 UST FinX operates as a long\-term transformation partner, helping financial institutions reduce operational risk, simplify complex technology landscapes, strengthen engineering maturity, and accelerate the delivery of new banking capabilities.
   

  

 We are building the platform engineering foundation that enables the next generation of digital banking.

 At Hitachi Energy, we are accelerating our digital transformation journey by optimizing and modernizing global transportation and logistics operations. As a SAP TM Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in defining, designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise\-wide transportation management solutions that enable efficient, scalable, and intelligent logistics processes across our global business landscape.
   

  

 In this role, you will combine transportation management expertise, solution architecture leadership, and emerging technologies such as SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation and operational excellence. You will lead SAP TM transformation initiatives, define strategic roadmaps, and deliver robust, integrated logistics solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Define and govern the SAP TM solution architecture strategy, standards, and roadmap across global business functions.

* Ensure solution alignment with enterprise architecture principles, cybersecurity requirements, compliance regulations, and digital transformation objectives.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution governance forums, and technical decision\-making processes.
* Design and optimize SAP TM capabilities including Freight Unit Building, Transportation Planning, Load Planning and Optimization, Carrier Selection, Freight Order Management, Transportation Execution, Freight Settlement, Cost Allocation, Charge Management, Logistics Visibility, and Event Tracking.

* Enable event\-driven and API\-based architectures to support modern business processes and integrations.
* Define and lead AI\-enabled transportation optimization strategies.
* Evaluate AI and machine learning use cases including route optimization, shipment consolidation, predictive freight planning, load planning optimization, transportation exception management, and logistics cost optimization.
* Support the integration of AI services within SAP solutions and external platforms.
* Lead adoption and integration of SAP Business Network for Logistics (BN4L), including carrier collaboration, freight tendering, shipment tracking, and logistics visibility capabilities.
* Strengthen collaboration with carriers, freight forwarders, logistics providers, and external business partners.
* Define end\-to\-end integration architecture between SAP TM and connected systems, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP GTS, SAP BTP, BN4L, third\-party logistics providers, and external carrier platforms.
* Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure integrations using APIs, IDocs, events, middleware technologies, and SAP Integration Suite.

* Proven experience as an SAP TM Solution Architect within complex global organizations.
* Strong expertise in transportation management, logistics operations, freight management, and supply chain processes.
* Experience delivering global SAP implementation, transformation, and rollout programs.
* Deep knowledge of SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM) and SAP S/4HANA TM.

* Strong technical architecture knowledge covering ABAP OO, BOPF, FPM, CDS Views, OData Services, APIs, BRF\+, Enhancement Framework, and SAP Integration Suite.

* Strong understanding of cloud\-based architectures, integration patterns, and event\-driven solutions.

* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem\-solving, decision\-making, and productivity, while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, cross\-functional, and multicultural environment.

title: Principal Software Architect
description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

Your Impact
  
Sets data and applied AI architecture direction for OpenText, working across product lines rather than within a single team. Defines how OpenText builds and governs data platforms (warehousing, lakehouses, graphs, vector stores) and the applied AI systems built on top of them. Acts as a technical authority that other architects and engineering teams consult on data and applied AI decisions.
  
What the role offers
  
1\.Design and review data architectures (warehouses, lakehouses, data platforms, graph and vector stores) that support analytics and AI workloads, including data quality, lineage, and governance (e.g., using layered patterns such as medallion/bronze\-silver\-gold where applicable).
  
2\.Evaluate and recommend data contract and product standards (e.g., ODCS, ODPS) for cross\-product adoption.
  
3\.Define reference architectures and patterns for applied AI systems (RAG, agentic AI, LLM integration) that other product teams can adopt, including governance considerations such as safety filtering, bias assessment, human\-in\-the\-loop mechanisms, and audit evidence requirements for autonomous/agentic systems.
  
4\.Advise on agentic AI architecture, including interoperability protocols such as MCP and A2A as well as emerging standards such as OpenID AuthZEN and OIDC\-A.
  
5\.Partner with product architects across OpenText to align data and AI architecture decisions with company\-wide standards. 6\.Represent data engineering and applied AI perspectives in architecture review boards and standards discussions. 7\.Communicate architectural trade\-offs to executive and non\-technical stakeholders, influencing direction across product lines without formal authority.
  
8\.Mentor other architects informally on data engineering and applied AI practices, without formal people\-management responsibility.
  
  

**What you need to succeed:**  

1\.10\+ years in software architecture, data engineering, or AI/ML systems, or equivalent demonstrated depth.
  
2\.Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
  
3\.Track record operating as a software architect across multiple teams or products, not just within a single team.
  
4\. Demonstrated design of production data architectures at scale (e.g., data warehouse, lakehouse, or data platform), using layered patterns such as medallion/bronze\-silver\-gold where applicable.
  
5\.Hands\-on experience architecting applied AI systems (e.g., RAG pipelines, LLM\-integrated services) that have shipped to production.
  
6\.Experience building cloud\-native applications on a major hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerized applications deployed on Kubernetes.
  
One last thing
  
Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  
Prior cross\-product or cross\-org architecture role at a similarly sized enterprise software company.
  
Breadth across data warehousing, lakehouses, data platforms, graphs, and vector technologies, valued over deep specialization in a single area.
  
Familiarity with data contract/product standards such as ODCS (Open Data Contract Standard) or ODPS (Open Data Product Specification).
  
Familiarity with data catalog and metadata management tools (e.g., Unity Catalog, Google Cloud Dataplex Universal Catalog, Apache Atlas, or equivalent).
  
Experience with graph databases and building knowledge graphs.
  
Experience with vector database technologies and embedding pipelines in production RAG systems (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, or equivalent).
  
Experience designing streaming data architectures (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Delta Live Tables, or equivalent) alongside batch/medallion patterns.
  
Experience with agentic AI architecture and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A) or similar emerging standards.
  
Familiarity with agentic AI safety patterns, including prompt injection defenses, guardrail design, and PII handling in agentic contexts.
  
  

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1\+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
**Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable embedded software frameworks, validation infrastructure, and platform software for pre\-silicon and post\-silicon SoC validation.
* Develop reusable framework components, platform abstraction layers, middleware, and system software services supporting multicore and heterogeneous compute environments.

* Debug and root\-cause complex system\-level issues spanning hardware, firmware, operating systems, framework software, memory subsystems, coherency fabrics, and system infrastructure IPs.
* Develop framework capabilities supporting multicore, multiprocessor, and heterogeneous CPU architectures, including system\-level synchronization, coherency, and performance optimization.
* Design, implement, and optimize automated validation, regression, and release workflows to improve productivity, quality, and scalability.
* Integrate static analysis, code\-quality tools, build systems, and release processes into Continuous Integration (CI) environments.
* Collaborate closely with architecture, design, verification, firmware, software, and validation teams to enable efficient silicon bring\-up, feature validation, and debug.
* Drive continuous improvements in software quality, framework architecture, automation, and validation methodologies.

**Minimum Qualification**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 6\+ to 10 years of industry experience in Embedded Software, System Software, SoC Validation, Silicon Enablement, Platform Software, Framework Development, or related domains.
* Proven experience in embedded software architecture, framework development, low\-level software design, and complex system\-level debug.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills in hardware\-software integrated environments.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Strong expertise in Embedded Software Architecture, Framework Design, and Infrastructure Development using C, C\+\+, and Assembly.
* Proven experience designing and developing scalable software frameworks, platform abstraction layers, middleware, validation infrastructure, and reusable system software components.
* Extensive experience in low\-level software development, including boot code, exception handling, interrupt management, startup sequences, and C\-Assembly interworking.
* Deep understanding of CPU architectures and microarchitectural concepts, including ARMv8/ARMv9, x86, and PowerPC architectures.
* Strong expertise in multicore, multiprocessor, and heterogeneous SoC environments, including SMP, AMP, heterogeneous compute subsystems, and cross\-core software interactions.
* Demonstrated ability to debug complex system\-level issues spanning hardware, firmware, operating systems, framework software, and validation infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of cache coherency, I/O coherency, memory ordering, synchronization primitives, inter\-processor communication, and concurrency\-related issues.
* Deep knowledge of SoC architecture, including compute subsystems, memory hierarchies, interconnect fabrics, power management, and system infrastructure IPs.
* Strong understanding of Operating Systems, RTOS, and Linux kernel internals, including multithreading, scheduling policies, locking mechanisms, interrupt handling, virtual memory, MMU architecture, and kernel synchronization primitives.
* Deep understanding of memory management, weakly ordered memory models, cache architectures, pipelining, memory barriers, TLBs, coherency protocols, and performance optimization techniques.
* Strong expertise in software build infrastructure, compiler toolchains, linker internals, Makefiles, linker/scatter scripts, and build system architecture.
* Proficiency with GCC, Clang/LLVM, ARM toolchains, code optimization techniques, and root\-causing complex compiler and linker issues.
* Strong debugging expertise using JTAG, trace, emulation, FPGA, and silicon debug tools.
* Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for automation, framework development, debug, and productivity tooling.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience architecting and developing large\-scale embedded software frameworks or validation infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams and SoC programs.
* Experience with silicon bring\-up, board bring\-up, post\-silicon validation, and hardware\-software integration.
* Hands\-on experience with pre\-silicon emulation, FPGA prototyping, and post\-silicon debug environments.
* Strong understanding of ARM\-based SoC architectures, memory hierarchies, cache coherency protocols, interconnect fabrics, and system infrastructure IPs.
* Experience developing framework abstractions supporting heterogeneous processing elements such as application processors, real\-time processors, DSPs, AI/ML accelerators, and security subsystems.
* Familiarity with CI/CD systems, automated regression infrastructure, release management, and software quality methodologies.
* Experience with JTAG, Lauterbach Trace32, hardware trace, and performance analysis tools.
* Experience with source code management systems such as Git and Perforce.
* Familiarity with build automation, containerized development environments, and scalable software deployment workflows.

* Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical direction for framework and infrastructure development initiatives.

**Job Description**  

HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build **HPE Networking**, with the ambition of creating the **best networking business on the planet**. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program**, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a **single platform**, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.


As part of a fast\-moving, **multi\-year transformation**, the team will stabilize near\-term operations, **migrate core** **platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally**, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with **business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.


For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help **build a new business unit from its earliest days**, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership**, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

**HPE Global IT is a dynamic organization enabling the enterprise to innovate and lead the industry with our consumption\-based IT transformation and our consulting, financial, educational, and operational support services. Join us as we develop innovative solutions that revolutionize how we help customers by simplifying their operations and move the world forward.**

**What you’ll do:**

**Workstream\-Specific Details**

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for services and software subscription offers across the combined HPE and Juniper portfolios, spanning quote, order, fulfillment, entitlement, and renewal.
* Translate subscription and SaaS commercial constructs — term, usage\-based, committed\-consumption, co\-term, and mid\-term change — into platform\-level design on the target L2C stack.
* Design and document subscription data models, product/offer structures, and integration patterns between CPQ, order management, entitlement, billing, and asset management systems.
* Partner with business, product, and pricing leaders to pressure\-test offer designs for feasibility, then define the architecture runway required to deliver them.
* Lead design reviews and architecture decision records; resolve cross\-workstream dependencies and drive alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Guide migration of subscription and support contracts from fragmented legacy systems onto the unified platform, including data mapping, reconciliation, and cutover design.
* Support build and test teams as the design authority — clarifying intent, reviewing configuration, and triaging defects that trace to architectural decisions.
* Identify and escalate architectural risks, technical debt, and scalability constraints with recommended mitigations to program leadership.

**Education And Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree an asset.
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise solution or application architecture, with at least 5 years focused on Lead\-to\-Cash, CPQ, order management, or subscription billing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience architecting services and software subscription offers (SaaS, term license, consumption\-based, and support/services contracts) at enterprise scale.
* Hands\-on delivery experience with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce CPQ, Oracle, Zuora, or comparable subscription and order management systems.
* Track record on large\-scale transformation, ERP/CRM migration, or post\-merger integration programs, including legacy data migration and cutover.
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed environment with onshore/offshore delivery teams.
* Relevant architecture or platform certifications (e.g., TOGAF, SAP, Salesforce) an asset.

**What you need to bring:**

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Deep knowledge of subscription commercial models — term, usage, committed consumption, co\-term, ramp, renewal, and mid\-term change — and how they are represented in system design.
* Strong command of quote\-to\-cash process design across CPQ, contracting, order orchestration, entitlement, provisioning, billing, and revenue recognition.
* Solid grasp of integration architecture: APIs, event\-driven patterns, middleware, and master data management across product, customer, and install\-base domains.
* Ability to produce clear architecture artifacts — solution designs, data models, interface specifications, and decision records — that development teams can build from.
* Analytical and structured problem solver, comfortable making design decisions with incomplete information and revisiting them as the program matures.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to explain technical trade\-offs to executives and business stakeholders in plain language.
* Collaborative working style with the credibility to act as design authority across multiple workstreams and vendors.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and the pace of a multi\-year integration program.

* Proven experience in metric‑driven verification, including functional and code coverage closure

* Experience with directed and constrained‑random verification methodologies
* Experience debugging complex design issues in simulation, emulation, and post‑silicon environments

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. title: Solution Architect
description:

About this opportunity


The Solution Architect – FinTech is responsible for defining, designing, and delivering end\-to\-end technical and business solutions across digital payments, mobile money, lending, KYC, digital identity, merchant solutions, and financial services platforms. This role requires strong financial domain knowledge, deep technical expertise, and the ability to work consultatively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. The architect will lead solution scoping, requirement analysis, technical design, and deployment oversight while ensuring compliance, security, performance, and regulatory alignment across markets.

  

Key Responsibilities


FinTech Solution Design \& Architecture  

Design scalable, secure, and regulatory\-compliant solutions for digital payments, wallets, merchant transactions, lending, credit scoring, and financial ecosystem integrations.  

Analyze customer financial operations, transaction flows, risk controls, and compliance requirements to define optimized solutions.  

Translate business requirements into detailed technical designs spanning cloud, APIs, microservices, protocols, and core financial systems.  

Ensure solutions adhere to financial industry standards (PCI\-DSS, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, AML/CFT, data privacy, etc.).  

Customer Engagement \& Consultative Advisory  

Engage with banks, fintech operators, mobile money providers, and partners to understand business goals and technical landscapes.  

Lead workshops, requirement sessions, and technical deep\-dives to define use cases and solution scope.  

Prepare and deliver technical proposals, architecture documents, and customer presentations.  

Support commercial teams with solution positioning, negotiation, and value articulation.Project Delivery \& Implementation Support  

Support implementation teams during development, integration, testing, and rollout of FinTech platforms.  

Provide architectural governance and ensure alignment with solution blueprint throughout delivery.  

Conduct infrastructure capacity planning, performance evaluation, and transaction throughput modeling.  

Work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations teams to ensure successful deployment.  

Cross\-Functional Collaboration  

Collaborate with product roadmap teams, R\&D, and engineering to translate market needs into platform features.  

Provide continuous feedback to improve solutions, architecture patterns, and product capabilities.

  

Technical Skills


Architecture design (cloud/on\-prem), microservices, containerization, high\-availability and DR setups.  

Performance tuning, capacity estimation, and infra planning for high\-volume financial transactions.


Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, mobile money, merchant acquiring, lending platforms, KYC/AML, fraud systems, and transaction processing.  

Experience with financial protocols and integrations — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST/JSON APIs, SOAP, SFTP, OAuth2, JWT, Webhooks.  

Knowledge of financial compliance, risk controls, settlement processes, reconciliation, and transaction dispute flows.  

Experience with AI/ML and automation in financial use cases (fraud detection, credit prediction, operational optimization).  

Business \& Leadership Skills  

Strong consultative and customer\-facing capabilities.  

Financial acumen to understand revenue models, pricing, ROI, and commercial impact.  

Ability to mentor, guide teams, and collaborate across multi\-functional units.  

Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and negotiation skills.
